definition_zh: 拿着；握住；举行；容纳；持有（观点等）
definition_en: to have something in your hands or keep it there; to organize an event; to contain; to keep an opinion or position
core_image: 一只手稳稳握住东西不松开；有时握住的是话筒、是会场、是一句观点
scene: 运动会上班长手里攥着班旗，一直没松开。The monitor held the class flag tightly during the sports meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 hold 是「握住、拿着」（第 1 个义项：用手握住东西）；班长用手攥着班旗，一直保持不松开。

pos.zh: 拿着；握住；举行；容纳；持有
握住；抓着（如 catch hold of）

collocations.zh: 持有票（票在手里或名下）

derivatives.zh: hold + -er（做动作的人）→ 持有者（如 ticket holder 持票人）
hold + -ing → 持有；持有的股份
house + hold 合成 → 家庭；一家人
hold + up → 耽搁；阻塞

senses.title: To have something in your hands
senses.definition: to have or keep something in your hands or arms
senses.definitionCN: 用双手或手臂拿住、握住某物
senses.example: She held the baby gently in her arms.
senses.exampleCN: 她轻轻地把婴儿抱在怀里。
senses.why: The core image is a hand that does not let go; everything else grows from this grip.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一只不松开的手，其他义项都从「握住」这一动作长出来。

senses.title: To organize an event
senses.definition: to organize an event such as a meeting or a match
senses.definitionCN: 组织召开会议、比赛等活动
senses.example: Our school will hold a sports meeting next Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们学校下周五将举行运动会。
senses.why: The whole class or school "grasps" one event in a fixed time and place, so the grip is turned into organizing.
senses.whyCN: 整个集体在固定时间地点「攥住」一场活动，握住的动作就转成了「举行」。

senses.title: To contain
senses.definition: if a container or space holds something, it can contain that amount
senses.definitionCN: 指容器或空间能装下一定量的东西
senses.example: This bottle holds one litre of water.
senses.exampleCN: 这个瓶子能装一升水。
senses.why: A container keeps what is inside from escaping, just as a hand keeps what it holds.
senses.whyCN: 容器把里面的东西「扣住」不让跑掉，正如手握住东西不松开。

senses.title: To keep an opinion or position
senses.definition: to keep an opinion, belief or position in your mind without changing it
senses.definitionCN: 在心里保持某种观点、看法或状态，不轻易改变
senses.example: Many people still hold this old belief about the moon.
senses.exampleCN: 很多人仍持有关于月亮的这一古老看法。
senses.why: A thought is held in the mind the way an object is held in the hand; both stay firmly in place.
senses.whyCN: 想法被心里「握住」，就像东西被手里握住一样，都稳稳待在原处。

intro.en: Hold comes from Old English healdan, a common Germanic verb meaning to keep or to guard.
intro.cn: hold 来自古英语 healdan，是日耳曼语族的常用动词，意为保管、守持。

items.en: Old English healdan meant to keep, to guard and to hold in the hand.
items.cn: 古英语 healdan 意为保管、守护，也指用手握住。

items.en: The word belongs to the Germanic family; Dutch houden and German halten are close relatives.
items.cn: 该词属日耳曼语族，荷兰语 houden、德语 halten 是它的近亲。

items.en: In Middle English the verb kept the senses of guarding and grasping, and began to mean keeping an opinion.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，该动词保留守护、抓握两义，并开始表示「保持观点」。

items.en: Modern English added everyday uses such as hold a meeting and hold on.
items.cn: 现代英语又发展出举行会议、稍等（hold on）等日常用法。

items.en: The deeper root before Germanic is reconstructed and not fully agreed on.
items.cn: 日耳曼语族之前的更深词根属重构形式，学界尚无定论。

note.en: The first group keeps words built on hold itself; the second group gives close words about keeping things.
note.cn: 第一组是由 hold 本身构成的词；第二组是表示「拿住、保管」的近义词。

entries.definition: the past form of hold
entries.definitionCN: hold 的过去式，义为「握住过」

entries.definition: a person who has or owns something
entries.definitionCN: 同根派生词，义为「持有者」

entries.definition: the people living together in one house
entries.definitionCN: 由 house 与 hold 合成，义为「家庭；一家人」

entries.definition: to take and keep a very firm hold
entries.definitionCN: 紧握；抓牢，比 hold 用力更大

entries.definition: to take hold of something quickly or firmly
entries.definitionCN: 迅速或牢牢抓住；也指领会

entries.definition: to take something from one place to another
entries.definitionCN: 携带；搬运，强调移动而非停留

normalIntro.en: Build the word from real phrases and relatives.
normalIntro.cn: 用真实搭配和同族词记住 hold。

normal.en: hold + on = keep holding, do not let go
normal.cn: hold + on＝继续握住＝坚持住；打电话时引申为「别挂断，稍等」。

normal.en: held is the past of hold: the hand held it yesterday
normal.cn: held 是 hold 的过去式：昨天那只手握过它。

normal.en: A meeting is held like something gripped by a whole group
normal.cn: 会议像被整个集体「攥在手里」一样被举行——hold a meeting。

normal.en: ticket holder = the person who holds the ticket
normal.cn: ticket holder＝握着票的人＝持票人，-er 表示人。

normal.en: Dutch houden and German halten share the same old root
normal.cn: 荷兰语 houden、德语 halten 与 hold 同根，一家人记三个词。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closed around a small bird: firm but gentle.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手轻拢住一只小鸟：握得稳，又不伤它——hold 的分寸感。

abstract.en: Picture a hall that holds a thousand people without spilling one.
abstract.cn: 想象一个大厅「装下」一千个人，一个也不漏——容纳的画面。

abstract.en: Feel your opinion like a stone kept in your pocket.
abstract.cn: 把观点感受成口袋里一直揣着的一块小石头——持有的分量。

examples.en: He held the door open for the old lady.
examples.cn: 他为老奶奶扶住了门。

examples.en: The classroom holds forty students.
examples.cn: 这间教室能容纳四十名学生。

examples.en: Please hold on a moment; I will check it for you.
examples.cn: 请稍等一下，我帮你查一查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「候的」——候着的那只手一直没放下，稳稳握住东西，就是 hold（握住；持有）。

root: hold 来自古英语 healdan（保管、守持），属日耳曼语族本族动词，荷兰语 houden、德语 halten 同源；更早词根属重构，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: From a hand that will not let go grow four uses: gripping, organizing, containing and keeping beliefs.
sensesIntro.cn: hold 的四个义项都从「不松开的手」长出来：握住东西、举办活动、容纳物品、持有想法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that will not let go
core.cn: 核心意象：一只不松开的手

branches.en: the hand grips an object
branches.cn: 手握住实物（义项 01）

branches.en: a group grips one event in time
branches.cn: 集体把一场活动「攥」在固定时间里（义项 02）

branches.en: a container keeps things inside
branches.cn: 容器把东西扣在里面（义项 03）

branches.en: the mind holds an idea in place
branches.cn: 心里把想法握在原处（义项 04）

branches.en: holding on means not letting go
branches.cn: 坚持住就是不松手（义项 01 · 04）

intro.en: Hold is a native Germanic verb with a small but useful English family.
intro.cn: hold 是日耳曼本族动词，词族不大但很常用。

latinIntro.en: It has no Latin ancestor; Latin tenere is listed for contrast as the Latin verb of holding.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁祖先；拉丁语 tenere（握、持有）列出作对照。

items.example: Hold my hand at the crossing.
She held the rope all night.
The ticket holder entered first.

items.meaning: the act of holding; property held
items.example: The bank holds a large share holding.
items.exampleCN: 这家银行持有一大笔股份。

items.example: Hold on, the bus is coming.

items.meaning: a family living in one house
items.example: Every household has a TV now.
items.exampleCN: 现在每家都有一台电视。

items.example: The accident caused a hold-up.
Latin tenere builds contain and retain.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁 tenere 构成了 contain 与 retain。

definition_zh: 洞；孔；坑；漏洞
definition_en: an empty space or opening in something solid, or a gap where something is missing
core_image: 固体上被挖空的一块：能看穿它、能掉进去，也能藏东西
scene: 球场上有个小坑，足球正好滚了进去。The ball rolled into a hole on the playground and stopped there.
sceneCN: 这里 hole 是「坑；洞」（第 1 个义项：实体上的空腔）；球滚进场上的小坑里停住了。

derivatives.zh: hole + -y → 有洞的；多孔的
与 hole 同族相关词 → 空心的；中空的
凹陷处；洼地

senses.title: An opening or cavity in something solid
senses.definition: an empty space or opening in something solid
senses.definitionCN: 实体物上的空腔或开口
senses.example: The rabbit disappeared into a hole in the ground.
senses.exampleCN: 兔子钻进地上的洞不见了。
senses.why: The core sense is a space made where solid material should be.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是「本该是实体的地方空了出来」。

senses.title: A gap where something is missing
senses.definition: a place where part of something important is missing
senses.definitionCN: 重要内容缺失的部分
senses.example: There is a hole in his story that nobody noticed.
senses.exampleCN: 他的说法里有个没人注意到的漏洞。
senses.why: A missing part of a story looks like a missing piece of a wall: an empty space in something solid.
senses.whyCN: 故事里缺了一块，就像墙上缺了一块：实体中留出了空位。

senses.title: An awkward or difficult situation
senses.definition: an unpleasant or difficult situation that is hard to get out of
senses.definitionCN: 难以摆脱的困难处境
senses.example: After losing the money, he felt he was in a deep hole.
senses.exampleCN: 丢了钱之后，他觉得自己陷入了一个深坑。
senses.why: Being stuck in a hole with steep sides makes a natural picture for a problem you cannot walk out of.
senses.whyCN: 待在四壁陡峭的坑里出不来，正好用来形容走不出的困境。

intro.en: Hole comes from Old English hol, an adjective meaning hollow, itself from the root of the verb helan, to hide.
intro.cn: hole 来自古英语 hol（中空的），其源头是动词 helan「藏、隐」的词根。

items.en: Old English hol meant hollow; the noun hole grew out of this adjective.
items.cn: 古英语 hol 意为「中空的」，名词 hole 由这个形容词演变而来。

items.en: The verb helan meant to hide or conceal; a hole is a space hidden inside solid matter.
items.cn: 古英语动词 helan 意为藏匿；洞正是藏在实体内部的空腔。

items.en: The family is Germanic; Dutch hol and German hohl show the same shape of meaning.
items.cn: 该词属日耳曼语族，荷兰语 hol、德语 hohl 意义相近。

items.en: In Middle English the noun was written hol or hole and named pits, burrows and openings.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 hol 或 hole，用来称呼坑、洞穴与开口。

items.en: Modern English widened the noun to gaps in stories, records and situations.
items.cn: 现代英语把该名词扩展到故事、记录与处境中的「空白、漏洞」。

note.en: Group one collects the sound-alike and same-root words; group two collects other names for openings.
note.cn: 第一组是同音与同根词；第二组是表示「开口、空腔」的近义词。

entries.definition: complete; all of something; it only sounds the same as hole
entries.definitionCN: 完整的；全部的；与 hole 同音但拼写与意义都不同

entries.definition: empty inside; having a hole or hollow space
entries.definitionCN: 中空的；与 hole 同族，指内部有空腔

entries.definition: full of holes
entries.definitionCN: 同根派生词，义为「有洞的；多孔的」

entries.definition: a large deep hole in the ground
entries.definitionCN: 地上又大又深的坑

entries.definition: a long passage dug through something
entries.definitionCN: 隧道；通道，强调可以通行

entries.definition: a space between two things or a missing part
entries.definitionCN: 缺口；缝隙，也指差距

normalIntro.en: Use sound pairs and real phrases to fix the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用同音对照与真实搭配记住 hole。

normal.en: hole and whole sound the same: the hole is empty, the whole is full
normal.cn: hole 与 whole 同音：hole 是空的洞，whole 是完整的全。

normal.en: dig a hole: the spade makes the empty space
normal.cn: dig a hole：铲子挖出的正是那块「空」。

normal.en: black hole: even light falls in and cannot get out
normal.cn: black hole：连光都掉进去出不来——洞的极端版。

normal.en: holey socks let the toes see the light
normal.cn: holey 的袜子让脚趾「见到光」——满是洞。

normal.en: A hole in a story is a missing piece, like a hole in a wall
normal.cn: 故事里的 hole 是缺了一块，像墙上缺了个洞。

abstract.en: Picture a solid wall, then a round empty circle where the wall used to be.
abstract.cn: 想象一面结实的墙，再想象墙上凭空空出一个圆——那就是 hole。

abstract.en: Picture a rabbit disappearing: the ground opens and closes behind it.
abstract.cn: 想象兔子一钻，地面开合，转眼无踪——地洞的画面。

abstract.en: Feel a deep hole as a problem: steep sides, no ladder.
abstract.cn: 把深坑感受成困境：四壁陡峭，没有梯子。

examples.en: The workers dug a hole for the new tree.
examples.cn: 工人们为新树苗挖了一个坑。

examples.en: There is a small hole in my sock.
examples.cn: 我的袜子上有个小洞。

examples.en: Mouse holes appeared along the old wall.
examples.cn: 老墙沿线出现了几个鼠洞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「厚哦」——墙面很厚，却「哦」地空了一块，透出光来，这就是 hole（洞）。

root: hole 来自古英语 hol「中空的」，与古英语动词 helan「藏」相关，属日耳曼语族本族词；荷兰语 hol、德语 hohl 同源。

sensesIntro.en: From a physical opening the word extends to missing parts of stories and to hard situations.
sensesIntro.cn: hole 从实体上的开口，扩展到故事里的漏洞与难以脱身的困境。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty space inside something solid
core.cn: 核心意象：实体内部的一块空

branches.en: a space you can see through or fall into
branches.cn: 能看穿或掉进去的空腔（义项 01）

branches.en: a missing part in words or records
branches.cn: 说法或记录里缺的一块（义项 02）

branches.en: a hard place with steep sides
branches.cn: 四壁陡峭、难以脱身的困境（义项 03）

branches.en: falling in is easy, getting out is not
branches.cn: 掉进去容易爬出来难（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: a gap that lets light or error through
branches.cn: 让光或错误钻进来的缺口（义项 02）

intro.en: Hole is a short native noun with a tiny family, mostly adjectives.
intro.cn: hole 是短小的本族名词，词族不大，以形容词为主。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word is its ancestor; Latin foramen is given for contrast.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁祖先；拉丁语 foramen（孔）列出作对照。

items.example: A hole appeared in the road.
The old adjective gave the noun its shape.
items.exampleCN: 这个古英语形容词孕育了名词。

items.example: A hole hides inside solid matter.
His holey sweater lost a button too.
items.exampleCN: 他满是洞的毛衣还掉了一颗扣子。

items.example: The hollow tree hid the cat.
The whole class went to the museum.

items.meaning: a region where even light cannot escape
items.example: Black holes bend space itself.
items.exampleCN: 黑洞能使空间本身弯曲。

items.example: Latin foramen builds foramen magnum.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁 foramen 构成 foramen magnum。

definition_zh: 假日；节日；假期
definition_en: a day or period when people rest from work or school, or a special day of celebration
core_image: 把工作推开的日子：日历上被涂亮的一天，人们放下书本外出
scene: 暑假第一天，教室里空了，操场只剩蝉声。On the first day of the summer holiday, the classroom was empty and only cicadas sang.
sceneCN: 这里 holiday 是「假期」（第 2 个义项：连续休息的一段时间）；暑假开始后教室空了，学生都放假了。

collocations.zh: 银行假日（英国法定假日）

derivatives.zh: holiday + maker（制造者）→ 度假者（英式用法）
与 holy 同源 → 神圣的（词源关联词）
出门度假的人，尤指去海边或营地

senses.title: A special day of celebration
senses.definition: a special day when people celebrate or remember something
senses.definitionCN: 人们庆祝或纪念某事的特殊日子
senses.example: The Spring Festival is the biggest holiday of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 春节是一年中最大的节日。
senses.why: A day "made holy" for an event naturally becomes a day of celebration.
senses.whyCN: 为某事而「被定为圣日」的那一天，自然成了庆祝的日子。

senses.title: A period of rest from work or school
senses.definition: a time when you do not go to work or school and can rest or travel
senses.definitionCN: 不上班、不上学，可以休息或旅行的时段
senses.example: They spent their summer holiday at their grandparents’ home.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在祖父母家度过了暑假。
senses.why: One special day grows into a whole stretch of days set aside from ordinary work.
senses.whyCN: 从单个特殊日子，扩展成整段放下日常工作的日子。

senses.title: A trip taken during that time
senses.definition: a journey or trip made during a rest period
senses.definitionCN: 假期里进行的旅行或外出
senses.example: Our family holiday to the seaside was the best week of the year.
senses.exampleCN: 我们全家去海边的度假之旅是一年中最好的一周。
senses.why: The rest period and what you do in it share one word: the time becomes the trip.
senses.whyCN: 休息时段与在时段里做的事共用一词：时间本身变成了旅行。

intro.en: Holiday is Old English haligdaeg, literally holy day, the day made holy by religion.
intro.cn: holiday 来自古英语 haligdaeg，字面义是「神圣的日子」，即被宗教定为圣日的日子。

items.en: Haligdaeg joined halig, holy, with daeg, day: a day set apart for religion.
items.cn: 古英语 haligdaeg 由 halig（神圣的）与 daeg（日子）构成：专用于宗教的日子。

items.en: In Middle English the spelling became holidai and the religious link began to loosen.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 holidai，与宗教的联系开始松动。

items.en: By modern times any day of rest or festival, sacred or not, could be a holiday.
items.cn: 到近代，无论是否神圣，任何休息日或节日都可称 holiday。

items.en: British English keeps holiday for the whole vacation, while American English prefers vacation.
items.cn: 英式英语用 holiday 指整个假期，美式英语则多用 vacation。

items.en: Both halves of the word are Germanic: holy and day are native English words.
items.cn: 这个词的两半都是日耳曼成分：holy 与 day 都是英语本族词。

note.en: Group one shows the holy root and its relatives; group two shows other words for rest and celebration.
note.cn: 第一组是 holy 词根及其关联词；第二组是表示休息与庆祝的其他说法。

entries.definition: connected with religion or sacred things
entries.definitionCN: 与宗教或神圣事物相关的；holiday 的词源前半

entries.definition: to make holy, as in All Hallows’ Eve
entries.definitionCN: 使神圣；见于万圣节前夜的名称

entries.definition: a person travelling for pleasure
entries.definitionCN: 度假者，由 holiday + maker 构成

entries.definition: the American word for a period of rest from work or school
entries.definitionCN: 美式说法，指休息或放假的一段时间

entries.definition: a special event of celebration, often with shows
entries.definitionCN: 节庆活动，常含演出，强调庆祝本身

entries.definition: a short rest from work or school
entries.definitionCN: 短暂休息或短假，时间较短

normalIntro.en: Split the word into its two visible parts.
normalIntro.cn: 把 holiday 拆成两个看得见的部分来记。

normal.en: holy + day = a holy day
normal.cn: holy（神圣的）+ day（日子）＝「神圣的日子」，即节日、假日。

normal.en: All Hallows’ Eve keeps the old holy root alive
normal.cn: All Hallows’ Eve（万圣节前夜）保留了古老的 holy 词根。

normal.en: go on holiday: British people pack a suitcase
normal.cn: go on holiday：英国人一说这句就收拾行李——去度假。

normal.en: holidaymaker = one who makes a holiday
normal.cn: holidaymaker＝「制造假日的人」＝度假者。

normal.en: vacation is its American cousin with the same meaning
normal.cn: vacation 是它的美式「表亲」，意思相同。

abstract.en: Picture one square on the calendar painted bright gold.
abstract.cn: 想象日历上的一个格子被涂成亮金色——被特别标出的那一天。

abstract.en: Picture heavy schoolbags set down in a row at the classroom door.
abstract.cn: 想象一排沉重的书包齐齐放倒在教室门口——放假了。

abstract.en: Feel time slowing down when the bell rings for the last lesson.
abstract.cn: 感受最后一课铃响后时间慢下来——假期开始了。

examples.en: We visited the seaside town during the summer holiday.
examples.cn: 暑假期间我们去了那座海边小城。

examples.en: The shop was closed for a public holiday.
examples.cn: 因为法定假日，商店关门了。

examples.en: Christmas is my favourite holiday of the year.
examples.cn: 圣诞节是我一年中最喜欢的节日。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈莉days」——哈莉欢天喜地连玩好几天，玩的就是 holiday（假日；假期）。

root: holiday 由古英语 halig（神圣的）+ daeg（日子）构成，字面义「圣日」；两个成分均为日耳曼本族词，与 holy、hallow 同根。

sensesIntro.en: From one holy day the word widens to any festival, then to whole rest periods and the trips made in them.
sensesIntro.cn: holiday 从单独的圣日，扩展到各种节日，再到整段假期与假期中的旅行。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a day lifted out of ordinary time
core.cn: 核心意象：从寻常日子里被单独拎出来的一天

branches.en: a day set apart for celebration
branches.cn: 被专门定出来庆祝的日子（义项 01）

branches.en: a stretch of days off work or school
branches.cn: 一连串不用上班上学的日子（义项 02）

branches.en: the trip taken in that stretch
branches.cn: 在这段时间里进行的旅行（义项 03）

branches.en: religious days and rest days share one word
branches.cn: 宗教节日与休息日共用一词（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: rest turns into travel
branches.cn: 休息延伸为出行（义项 02 · 03）

intro.en: Holiday is a compound of two native words, holy and day, and needs no Latin help.
intro.cn: holiday 由本族词 holy 与 day 复合而成，不需要拉丁成分。

latinIntro.en: Latin feria, festival day, is given for contrast; Spanish and Italian fiesta and ferie come from it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 feria（节日）列出作对照；西班牙语、意大利语的 fiesta、ferie 均源于它。

items.meaning: a day of rest or celebration
items.example: Tomorrow is a holiday.
The church stands on holy ground.
items.exampleCN: 教堂建在神圣的土地上。

items.example: Day after day it rained.
Hallowed be thy name.
The beach was full of holidaymakers.
The long vacation begins in July.
A music festival filled the square.

items.meaningCN: 节日；假日的拉丁对照词
items.example: Feria gave Spanish fiesta.
items.exampleCN: feria 演变出西班牙语 fiesta。

definition_zh: 家；家庭；住宅；本垒；（副词）在家；回家
definition_en: the place where you live and feel you belong, or the base in a game; as an adverb, at or to your home
core_image: 一扇为你留灯的门：无论走多远，最终指向的那个落脚点
scene: 放学路上起了小雨，他推开家门闻到饭香。When he got home, dinner was already on the table.
sceneCN: 这里 home 是副词「回家；到家」（第 4 个义项：朝向家的方向）；get home 表示到家这个动作。

collocations.zh: 在家；像在家里一样自在

derivatives.zh: home + work → 家庭作业（在家里做的功课）
home + town → 家乡；故乡
home + land → 祖国；家园
home + -less（无）→ 无家可归的
home + -ly → 家常的；朴素的（英式）

senses.title: The place where you live
senses.definition: the house or place where you live and feel you belong
senses.definitionCN: 你居住并有归属感的房子或地方
senses.example: A small flat can still be a warm home.
senses.exampleCN: 小公寓也可以是温暖的家。
senses.why: The core sense is the fixed point that stays yours while everything else moves.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是那个属于你、不随外物移动的固定落脚点。

senses.title: The family living there
senses.definition: the family and household life connected with that place
senses.definitionCN: 与那个地方相连的家庭生活
senses.example: She left home at eighteen to study in another city.
senses.exampleCN: 她十八岁离家去别的城市读书。
senses.why: The place and the people in it are felt as one; leaving home means leaving both.
senses.whyCN: 地方与里面的人被视为一体；离家意味着同时离开两者。

senses.title: The base or safe position
senses.definition: the base you return to in a game, or a safe place for animals
senses.definitionCN: 比赛中要返回的基地，或动物的安全栖身处
senses.example: The runner reached home just before the tag.
senses.exampleCN: 跑垒员在触杀前一刻到达本垒。
senses.why: In a game the goal is to get back to where you started: home is the point you defend and return to.
senses.whyCN: 比赛的目标是回到出发点：home 既是守护点，也是要回到的点。

senses.title: At or toward your home (adverb)
senses.definition: used to say that someone is, or is going, to their own house
senses.definitionCN: 表示某人在家或正朝家走
senses.example: The children went home early because of the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 因为下雨，孩子们早早回家了。
senses.why: English lets the noun point the way: go home needs no preposition because home itself shows direction.
senses.whyCN: 英语让名词直接指示方向：go home 不用介词，因为 home 本身就带着「朝家」的方向。

intro.en: Home comes from Old English ham, meaning village, estate and dwelling, a word at the heart of Germanic life.
intro.cn: home 来自古英语 ham，意为村庄、宅地、居所，是日耳曼生活的核心词。

items.en: Old English ham meant not just a house but a village or estate with its people and fields.
items.cn: 古英语 ham 不只是房子，还指带人口与田地的村庄或宅地。

items.en: The root runs through the whole Germanic world: German Heim, Heimat and Dutch heem share it.
items.cn: 词根贯穿整个日耳曼世界：德语 Heim、Heimat 与荷兰语 heem 同源。

items.en: Old Norse heim, meaning world or home, appears in place names and in the word Holmes.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 heim 意为世界或家，见于地名与姓氏 Holmes。

items.en: In Middle English home settled into its modern form and the adverb use grew strong.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，home 定形为现在的拼写，副词用法日益常用。

items.en: Modern English built a large compound family: homework, hometown, homeland, homeless.
items.cn: 现代英语以其为轴造出大量复合词：homework、hometown、homeland、homeless。

note.en: Group one keeps the same-root relatives and compounds; group two keeps near words for dwelling and belonging.
note.cn: 第一组是同根词与复合词；第二组是表示居所与归属的近义词。

entries.definition: school work done at home
entries.definitionCN: home + work 构成，义为「家庭作业」

entries.definition: without a place to live
entries.definitionCN: 同根反义词，义为「无家可归的」

entries.definition: the town where you were born or grew up
entries.definitionCN: home + town 构成，义为「家乡」

entries.definition: the building itself, without the feeling
entries.definitionCN: 房子本身，强调建筑物

entries.definition: the group of related people
entries.definitionCN: 家庭；强调人的群体

entries.definition: a place where people live, used in formal writing
entries.definitionCN: 住所；居所，较正式

normalIntro.en: Use the visible compound family to fix the word.
normalIntro.cn: 借助看得见的复合词族记住 home。

normal.en: home + work = the work you take home
normal.cn: home + work＝带回家做的功课＝家庭作业。

normal.en: go home needs no preposition: home itself points the way
normal.cn: go home 不用介词：home 本身就指着家的方向。

normal.en: German Heim and Heimat are cousins of home
normal.cn: 德语 Heim、Heimat 是 home 的「表亲」，一家记三词。

normal.en: home + less = without a home
normal.cn: home + -less＝没有家＝无家可归的。

normal.en: the home team defends its own ground
normal.cn: 主队守卫自己的地盘——home 的「基地」义。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp left on in a window for you alone.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗里为你一个人留着的灯——家的意象。

abstract.en: Picture a base runner turning the last corner toward the plate.
abstract.cn: 想象跑垒员转过最后一个弯冲向本垒——「回家得分」。

abstract.en: Feel the word as a dot on the map that always pulls you back.
abstract.cn: 把这个词感受成地图上永远把你往回拉的那个点。

examples.en: After the long trip, the train finally carried them home.
examples.cn: 长途旅行后，火车终于把他们载回了家。

examples.en: My home town has changed a lot in ten years.
examples.cn: 十年间我的家乡变化很大。

examples.en: The cat found its way home across three streets.
examples.cn: 那只猫穿过三条街自己找回了家。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「厚木」——再厚的墙、再多的木头，围起来守着灯的那处才是 home（家）。

root: home 来自古英语 ham「村庄、宅地、居所」，属日耳曼本族词，德语 Heim、Heimat、荷兰语 heem 同源；古诺斯语 heim「世界；家」亦为其亲属。

sensesIntro.en: One word covers the place, the people, the base you return to, and the direction toward it.
sensesIntro.cn: home 一词兼指住所、家人、要返回的基地，以及朝向它的方向。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fixed point that always pulls you back
core.cn: 核心意象：永远把你往回拉的固定点

branches.en: the building that is yours
branches.cn: 属于你的居所（义项 01）

branches.en: the people inside it
branches.cn: 住在一起的人（义项 02）

branches.en: the point you defend and return to
branches.cn: 要守住也要返回的点（义项 03）

branches.en: the direction written into the noun
branches.cn: 写进名词里的方向感（义项 04）

branches.en: leaving home means leaving both
branches.cn: 离家意味着同时离开地方与家人（义项 01 · 02）

intro.en: Home is a native word that works as a noun, an adverb and the front of many compounds.
intro.cn: home 是本族词，可作名词、副词，还是许多复合词的前半。

latinIntro.en: Latin domus is the classic near-equivalent; it builds domestic and domicile.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 domus（家）是经典对照词，派生出 domestic 与 domicile。

items.example: East or west, home is best.
The birds flew home at sunset.
Finish your homework before dinner.
She misses her hometown very much.
They fought to defend their homeland.
The storm left many families homeless.
items.exampleCN: 风暴使许多家庭无家可归。

items.meaning: relax as if in your own house
items.meaningCN: 别拘束；像在自己家一样
items.example: Come in and make yourself at home.
Domus builds domestic and domicile.
items.exampleCN: domus 派生出 domestic 与 domicile。

definition_zh: 家庭作业；课外作业；功课
definition_en: school work that a student must do at home after lessons
core_image: 放学后摊开在餐桌上的练习册：白天课堂的延长线
scene: 晚饭前的餐桌上摊着练习册，铅笔沙沙响。He finished his homework just before dinner was ready.
sceneCN: 这里 homework 是「家庭作业」（第 1 个义项：课后要完成的功课）；他在开饭前刚刚写完作业。

derivatives.zh: house + work → 家务活（与 homework 相对）
work + book → 练习册
homework + -er → 在家工作的人（居家办公者）

senses.title: Tasks given to do after lessons
senses.definition: the written or reading tasks a teacher gives students to finish at home
senses.definitionCN: 老师布置给学生在家里完成的书面或阅读任务
senses.example: The teacher gave us some English homework for the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给我们布置了一些周末的英语作业。
senses.why: The word simply points to the place: work that follows you home from school.
senses.whyCN: 这个词直接指向地点：跟着你从学校回家的功课。

senses.title: Careful preparation before acting
senses.definition: the preparation or study done before a meeting, talk or decision
senses.definitionCN: 开会、发言或做决定之前所做的准备研究
senses.example: The new player did his homework and knew every opponent.
senses.exampleCN: 这位新队员做足了功课，对每个对手都了如指掌。
senses.why: School homework trains you to prepare before acting, so the word spread to all careful advance work.
senses.whyCN: 学校作业训练人「行动前先准备」，这个词便推广到一切事前功课。

intro.en: Homework is a plain English compound of home and work, first recorded in the seventeenth century for work done at home.
intro.cn: homework 是 home 与 work 的简单英语复合词，十七世纪已见于记载，指在家做的活。

items.en: Both parts are Old English: ham, dwelling, and weorc, task or labour.
items.cn: 两个成分都来自古英语：ham（居所）与 weorc（活计、劳动）。

items.en: In Middle English the two words were freely combined for all kinds of tasks done at home.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，两词自由组合，泛指在家做的各种活。

items.en: Early records show homework meaning piecework done at home, such as sewing or weaving.
items.cn: 早期记录中 homework 指在家做的计件活，如缝纫、织布。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the school meaning became the main one.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，「学校的课后作业」成为主要意义。

items.en: Modern English keeps both the school sense and the preparation sense.
items.cn: 现代英语同时保留学校义与「事前准备」义。

note.en: Group one shows the work family; group two shows related school words.
note.cn: 第一组是 work 词族；第二组是校园相关词。

entries.definition: cleaning and cooking done in the house
entries.definitionCN: 拼法相近，义为「家务活」，与作业无关

entries.definition: a book of practice exercises
entries.definitionCN: work + book 构成，义为「练习册」

entries.definition: the amount of work a person must do
entries.definitionCN: work + load 构成，义为「工作量」

entries.definition: a task given to a student, often longer
entries.definitionCN: 布置给学生的任务，常指较长或正式的作业

entries.definition: a set of practice questions
entries.definitionCN: 一组练习题，通常当堂完成

entries.definition: a piece of work to be done
entries.definitionCN: 一项要做的事，泛指任务

normalIntro.en: The compound explains itself; fix it with the family.
normalIntro.cn: 复合词本身自解释，用词族把它固定住。

normal.en: home + work = the work that follows you home
normal.cn: home + work＝跟着你回家的功课＝家庭作业。

normal.en: housework is for the house, homework is for school
normal.cn: housework 是家务，homework 是课业——一词之差，主人不同。

normal.en: do your homework before the match: prepare carefully
normal.cn: 比赛前 do your homework：做足功课，仔细准备。

normal.en: uncountable: homework never takes an -s
normal.cn: homework 不可数，从不加 -s。

normal.en: hand in homework means to give it to the teacher
normal.cn: hand in homework＝把作业交给老师。

abstract.en: Picture the same desk used for dinner at six and sums at seven.
abstract.cn: 想象同一张餐桌：六点吃饭，七点算题——作业占领了餐桌。

abstract.en: Picture a schoolbag quietly carrying the classroom into your bedroom.
abstract.cn: 想象书包悄悄把课堂搬进卧室——作业的旅程。

abstract.en: Feel the word as a small debt paid each evening.
abstract.cn: 把这个词感受成每晚偿还的一笔小债。

examples.en: She does her homework every evening after dinner.
examples.cn: 她每天晚饭后做作业。

examples.en: How much homework did the teacher give you today?
examples.cn: 老师今天给你们布置了多少作业？

examples.en: The judge had done her homework before the trial began.
examples.cn: 开庭前法官已做足了功课。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「厚木窝」——趴在厚木桌的小窝里写的就是 homework（家庭作业）。

root: homework 由本族词 home（家）+ work（活计）复合而成；两部分均可上溯至古英语 ham 与 weorc，属日耳曼语族固有构词。

sensesIntro.en: The word points at a place: first the schoolwork done at home, then any careful preparation done in advance.
sensesIntro.cn: homework 由地点定位：先是放学后在家做的功课，再泛化为一切事前的认真准备。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the classroom carried into the living room
core.cn: 核心意象：课堂被搬进了客厅

branches.en: tasks that follow the student home
branches.cn: 跟着学生回家的任务（义项 01）

branches.en: advance study before an important step
branches.cn: 重要行动之前的研究准备（义项 02）

branches.en: both are work done before it is needed
branches.cn: 两者都是提前完成的工作（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: an evening habit with a pencil
branches.cn: 每晚与铅笔相伴的习惯（义项 01）

branches.en: knowing the opponent before the game
branches.cn: 赛前摸清对手（义项 02）

intro.en: Homework is a self-explaining compound of two native words.
intro.cn: homework 由两个本族词复合而成，字面即释义。

latinIntro.en: Latin labor is given for contrast; it builds laboratory and collaborate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 labor（劳动）列出作对照，派生出 laboratory 与 collaborate。

items.example: Finish your homework first.
home also appears in hometown.
items.exampleCN: home 也出现在 hometown 中。

items.example: The bridge took years of work.
items.exampleCN: 这座桥花了好几年工夫。

items.example: She shares the housework with her brother.
Write the answers in your workbook.

items.meaning: a person who works from home
items.example: Many designers are homeworkers now.
items.exampleCN: 如今许多设计师在家工作。

items.example: The new term doubled his workload.
items.exampleCN: 新学期让他的工作量翻倍。

items.example: Labor builds laboratory.

definition_zh: 诚实的；老实的；真诚的
definition_en: telling the truth and not cheating or stealing; showing sincerity
core_image: 摊开的手心：把知道的全部给你看，一点不藏
scene: 钱包躺在路边，他捡起后立刻交给了老师，没有打开看。He is honest: he returned the wallet without even opening it.
sceneCN: 这里 honest 是「诚实的」（第 1 个义项：不说谎、不贪心）；他捡到钱包原样归还，连看都没看。

derivatives.zh: honest + -y（性质名词后缀）→ 诚实；正直
honest + -ly → 诚实地；说实话
dis-（否定）+ honest → 不诚实的；撒谎的
dis- + honesty → 不诚实；欺诈

senses.title: Telling the truth
senses.definition: someone who is honest tells the truth and does not lie or cheat
senses.definitionCN: 说真话、不撒谎、不作弊的人
senses.example: An honest student wrote her own name on the list of wrong answers.
senses.exampleCN: 一名诚实的学生在错题名单上写下了自己的名字。
senses.why: The open hand is the picture: everything is shown, nothing hidden.
senses.whyCN: 意象是摊开的手心：全都亮给你看，毫无隐藏。

senses.title: Not stealing or cheating
senses.definition: not taking things that belong to others and not cheating in games or business
senses.definitionCN: 不拿别人的东西，不做游戏或生意中的手脚
senses.example: The honest shopkeeper gave back the extra change.
senses.exampleCN: 那位正直的店主退回了多找的零钱。
senses.why: Honesty keeps its hands still: what is not yours stays where it is.
senses.whyCN: 诚实的手不乱动：不属于你的东西就留在原处。

senses.title: Sincere and direct
senses.definition: showing real feelings and saying directly what you think
senses.definitionCN: 流露真实感受，直接说出想法
senses.example: To be honest, I did not like the film very much.
senses.exampleCN: 说实话，我不太喜欢那部电影。
senses.why: An honest word may be hard to hear, but it is given with an open heart.
senses.whyCN: 坦诚的话可能不好听，但出自一颗敞开的心。

intro.en: Honest came through Old French from Latin honestus, meaning honoured or respectable, from honos, honour.
intro.cn: honest 经古法语来自拉丁 honestus「受尊敬的、体面的」，其词根是 honos（荣誉）。

items.en: Latin honos meant honour and public respect; its adjective honestus meant respectable.
items.cn: 拉丁 honos 指荣誉与公众尊重，其形容词 honestus 意为体面的。

items.en: Old French honeste and oneste carried the word into medieval Europe.
items.cn: 古法语 honeste、oneste 把这个词带入中世纪欧洲。

items.en: Middle English borrowed honest around the thirteenth century, first meaning respectable.
items.cn: 中古英语约在十三世纪借入 honest，最初意为可敬的。

items.en: Modern English narrowed the sense to truthful and sincere.
items.cn: 现代英语把词义收窄为诚实的、真诚的。

items.en: The letter h is not pronounced: honest sounds like on-ist, so we say an honest person.
items.cn: h 不发音：honest 读作 on-ist，因此冠词用 an honest person。

note.en: Group one holds the silent-h family; group two holds words for truthfulness and fairness.
note.cn: 第一组是 h 不发音的词族；第二组是表示真实与公正的近义词。

entries.definition: great respect; a mark of respect
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「荣誉；尊敬」，h 也不发音

entries.definition: the quality of being honest
entries.definitionCN: 同根名词，义为「诚实」

entries.definition: a period of sixty minutes; the h is silent here too
entries.definitionCN: h 不发音的同类词，义为「小时」

entries.definition: always telling the truth
entries.definitionCN: 说真话的，强调言语真实

entries.definition: showing real feelings, not pretended
entries.definitionCN: 真诚的，强调发自内心

entries.definition: treating everyone equally and honestly
entries.definitionCN: 公平的，强调处事公正

normalIntro.en: Use the silent h family and real phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 用 h 不发音的词族与真实搭配记住 honest。

normal.en: honest, honour, hour: the h is silent in all three
normal.cn: honest、honour、hour 三个词的 h 都不发音，一起记。

normal.en: an honest answer, never a honest answer
normal.cn: 说 an honest answer，因为 honest 以元音开头。

normal.en: honest + -y = honesty, the name of the quality
normal.cn: honest + -y＝honesty，这种品质的名字。

normal.en: to be honest is a polite way to start a true opinion
normal.cn: to be honest 是坦白观点的礼貌开头：说实话。

normal.en: honest work means work earned by real effort
normal.cn: honest work 指凭真本事挣来的正当工作。

abstract.en: Picture two palms turned upward, completely empty.
abstract.cn: 想象两只摊开的手掌，空无一物——没藏任何东西。

abstract.en: Picture a shopkeeper sliding back one extra coin across the counter.
abstract.cn: 想象店主把一枚多找的硬币推回柜台对面。

abstract.en: Feel the weight lift when the truth is finally spoken.
abstract.cn: 感受真话终于说出口后心里变轻的那一瞬。

examples.en: The honest taxi driver returned the phone to the station.
examples.cn: 诚实的出租车司机把手机送回了车站。

examples.en: To be honest, the soup needs a little more salt.
examples.cn: 说实话，这汤还差点盐。

examples.en: A game is fun only when everyone plays honest.
examples.cn: 只有大家都守规矩，游戏才好玩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「昂奈斯特」——昂着头、内心（nai）踏实（st）的人不怕说真话，这就是 honest（诚实的）。

root: honest 经古法语来自拉丁 honestus「体面的」，词根为 honos「荣誉」，与 honour 同源；进入英语后词义由「可敬的」转为「诚实的」。

sensesIntro.en: From respectability in Latin to truthfulness in English, honest covers speech, hands and feelings.
sensesIntro.cn: honest 从拉丁语的「体面」转为英语的「诚实」，涵盖言语、行为与情感三个层面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: open palms with nothing hidden
core.cn: 核心意象：摊开的手心，毫无隐藏

branches.en: the mouth that tells only truth
branches.cn: 只说真话的嘴（义项 01）

branches.en: the hand that takes nothing extra
branches.cn: 不多拿一分的手（义项 02）

branches.en: the heart shown as it is
branches.cn: 如实呈现的心（义项 03）

branches.en: truth in speech and in feeling
branches.cn: 言语与情感中的真（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: fairness that earns respect
branches.cn: 赢得尊敬的公正（义项 02）

intro.en: Honest belongs to a Latin family built on honour, with one prefix and two suffixes.
intro.cn: honest 属于以「荣誉」为轴的拉丁词族，带一个前缀和两个后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin honos and honestus are the true ancestors; they also build honorary and honorarium.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 honos 与 honestus 是真正的祖先，还派生了 honorary 与 honorarium。

items.example: An honest person sleeps well.
Honos is the root of the family.
Honesty is the best policy.
He honestly admitted the mistake.
Dishonest advertising tricks buyers.

items.meaning: great respect; a mark of respect
items.example: It is an honour to meet you.

items.meaning: a payment for an honorary service
items.example: The speaker received an honorarium.
items.exampleCN: 演讲者收到了一笔酬金。

items.meaningCN: 忠诚可靠的（拉丁对照词）
items.example: Fidelis appears in Fidelio and fidelity.
items.exampleCN: fidelis 见于 Fidelio 与 fidelity。

definition_zh: 蜂蜜；甜心；亲爱的（称呼）
definition_en: the sweet sticky food made by bees, or a loving word for someone dear to you
core_image: 琥珀色的一勺金黄：甜得粘住舌尖，也甜在称呼里
scene: 面包刚烤好，奶奶抹上一层金黄的蜂蜜。Grandma spread some honey on the warm bread.
sceneCN: 这里 honey 是「蜂蜜」（第 1 个义项：蜜蜂酿的甜食）；奶奶往温热的面包上抹蜂蜜。

derivatives.zh: honey + bee → 蜜蜂
honey + moon → 蜜月（新婚第一个月最甜）
honey + -ed → 甜言蜜语的；加了蜜的
honey + pot → 蜜罐（引诱人的甜饵）

senses.title: The sweet food made by bees
senses.definition: a sweet, thick, golden food that bees make from flower nectar
senses.definitionCN: 蜜蜂用花蜜酿成的浓稠香甜的金黄色食物
senses.example: Bees store honey in the cells of the comb.
senses.exampleCN: 蜜蜂把蜂蜜储存在蜂巢的巢室里。
senses.why: The core sense is the sweet liquid itself, straight from the hive.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是蜂巢里取出的那勺甜液本身。

senses.title: A loving name for a dear person
senses.definition: a word you call someone you love, especially a partner or child
senses.definitionCN: 对所爱之人的称呼，多用于伴侣或孩子
senses.example: Honey, dinner is ready!
senses.exampleCN: 亲爱的，吃饭啦！
senses.why: The sweetness of the food became the sweetness of a person you call with love.
senses.whyCN: 食物的甜变成了人的甜：用一声「甜」呼唤所爱之人。

senses.title: Sweet flattery
senses.definition: pleasant words used to persuade someone, as in honeyed words
senses.definitionCN: 用来劝诱别人的动听话，如 honeyed words
senses.example: He won the deal with honeyed words and small promises.
senses.exampleCN: 他靠甜言蜜语和小许诺拿下了这笔生意。
senses.why: Sweet speech coats the tongue like honey coats bread, making hard words easy to swallow.
senses.whyCN: 甜话裹住舌头，就像蜂蜜裹住面包，让难听的话也容易咽下。

intro.en: Honey is an Old English word, hunig, from a Germanic root; Latin mel names the same sweet thing from another root.
intro.cn: honey 是古英语词 hunig，来自日耳曼词根；拉丁语 mel 用另一个词根命名同一种甜物。

items.en: Old English hunig named the bee’s sweet store; the -ig ending looks like the adjective ending -y.
items.cn: 古英语 hunig 指蜜蜂储存的甜物，词尾 -ig 与形容词后缀 -y 相像。

items.en: The root is Germanic: Dutch honig and German Honig keep the same shape.
items.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族：荷兰语 honig、德语 Honig 形状相同。

items.en: In Middle English the spelling settled as honey, and the loving use began to appear.
items.cn: 中古英语定型为 honey，爱的称呼用法开始出现。

items.en: Modern English added honeymoon in the sixteenth century and honeyed words later.
items.cn: 现代英语在十六世纪造出 honeymoon，后来又有了 honeyed words。

items.en: Latin mel is the classical name for honey; it builds mellifluous, flowing with honey.
items.cn: 拉丁 mel 是蜂蜜的古典名称，派生出 mellifluous（甜美如蜜流）。

note.en: Group one shows the honey compounds; group two shows the sweet and loving near words.
note.cn: 第一组是 honey 复合词；第二组是表示甜与亲昵的近义词。

entries.definition: the bee that makes honey
entries.definitionCN: honey + bee 构成，义为「蜜蜂」

entries.definition: the holiday taken by new married people
entries.definitionCN: honey + moon 构成，义为「蜜月」

entries.definition: sweetened with honey or flattering
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「加了蜜的；甜言蜜语的」

entries.definition: a loving word for someone dear
entries.definitionCN: 对心爱之人的爱称，义为「心上人」

entries.definition: a thick sweet liquid, made from sugar or plants
entries.definitionCN: 糖浆，浓稠的甜液，来源不同

entries.definition: the sweet liquid inside flowers
entries.definitionCN: 花蜜，蜂蜜的原料

normalIntro.en: Use the visible compounds and the sweet family.
normalIntro.cn: 用看得见的复合词与甜味词族记 honey。

normal.en: honey + moon = the sweetest first month of marriage
normal.cn: honey + moon＝婚姻最甜的第一个月＝蜜月。

normal.en: honey + bee = the bee that makes honey
normal.cn: honey + bee＝酿蜜的蜂＝蜜蜂。

normal.en: as sweet as honey describes taste and speech
normal.cn: as sweet as honey 既能说味道，也能说嘴甜。

normal.en: Honey, I am home: one word warms the door
normal.cn: Honey, I am home：一个词把门口都焐热了。

normal.en: mellifluous means flowing with honey, sweet to hear
normal.cn: mellifluous 字面是「流着蜜的」，形容声音甜美。

abstract.en: Picture one golden drop sliding slowly down the spoon.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴金黄缓缓顺着勺沿滑落——蜂蜜的慢与稠。

abstract.en: Picture a hive humming like a small warm engine.
abstract.cn: 想象蜂箱像一台温热的小引擎嗡嗡作响。

abstract.en: Feel a sweet word coat a hard sentence until it slides down.
abstract.cn: 感受一句甜话裹住生硬的句子，让它顺利下咽。

examples.en: Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂用花蜜酿出蜂蜜。

examples.en: Good words are like honey to a tired heart.
examples.cn: 好话对疲惫的心就像蜂蜜一样甜。

examples.en: They spent their honeymoon by the sea.
examples.cn: 他们在海边度过了蜜月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈尼」——喝一口蜜，甜得「哈」一声喊「尼（你）真甜」，这就是 honey（蜂蜜；甜心）。

root: honey 来自古英语 hunig，属日耳曼语族本族词，荷兰语 honig、德语 Honig 同源；拉丁语用另一词根 mel 命名蜂蜜，派生 mellifluous 等。

sensesIntro.en: From the bee’s sweet store, honey spreads to loving names and to flattery.
sensesIntro.cn: honey 从蜂巢的甜物出发，扩展为亲昵称呼，再到甜言蜜语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one golden drop of sweetness
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴金黄的甜

branches.en: the food of the hive
branches.cn: 蜂巢里酿出的食物（义项 01）

branches.en: the sweetness you call a dear one
branches.cn: 用来呼唤爱人的甜（义项 02）

branches.en: sweetness used as a tool
branches.cn: 被当成工具使用的甜（义项 03）

branches.en: taste and love share one sweetness
branches.cn: 味道与爱共用一份甜（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: the same sweetness, honest or not
branches.cn: 同一份甜，或真诚或不真诚（义项 02 · 03）

intro.en: Honey is a native Germanic word that works mainly as the front of compounds.
intro.cn: honey 是日耳曼本族词，主要用作复合词的前半。

latinIntro.en: Latin mel is the classical counterpart; it builds melon, mellow and mellifluous.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mel 是古典对照词，派生出 melon、mellow 与 mellifluous。

items.meaning: the sweet food made by bees
items.example: The jar of honey was almost empty.
A honeybee visits hundreds of flowers a day.
items.exampleCN: 一只蜜蜂一天访问数百朵花。

items.example: Their honeymoon lasted two weeks.
items.exampleCN: 他们的蜜月持续了两周。

items.example: She spoke with honeyed words.

items.meaning: a sweet trap to lure someone
items.example: The free gift was a honeypot for new users.
items.exampleCN: 免费赠品是给新用户设的诱饵。

items.example: Mel builds mellifluous and mellow.
items.exampleCN: mel 派生出 mellifluous 与 mellow。

items.example: Mellifluous voices suit slow songs.
Thanks, hon!

definition_zh: 尊敬；荣誉；光荣；荣幸；（动词）尊敬；给……荣誉
definition_en: great respect, or a special mark of respect; as a verb, to show respect for someone or something
core_image: 一枚别在胸前的奖章：被众人抬高的那个名字
scene: 升旗仪式上，全校安静地注视国旗，目光里满是敬意。The students stood up to honour the national flag.
sceneCN: 这里 honour 是动词「向……致敬」（第 4 个义项：表达尊敬）；学生起立，用注视与沉默表达对国旗的尊敬。

derivatives.zh: honour + -able（值得……的）→ 光荣的；可敬的
honour + -ed → 受到尊敬的；深感荣幸的
dis-（否定）+ honour → 耻辱；使蒙羞
荣誉的；名义上的（如 honorary member 名誉会员）

senses.title: Great respect
senses.definition: the respect that people show to someone they admire
senses.definitionCN: 人们对值得敬佩者所表达的敬重
senses.example: The old teacher was held in honour by three generations.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老教师受到三代人的敬重。
senses.why: The medal image is respect made visible: a name lifted above the crowd.
senses.whyCN: 奖章意象是让尊敬看得见：把一个名字抬到人群之上。

senses.title: A mark or prize of respect
senses.definition: something given to show respect, such as a prize or a title
senses.definitionCN: 用来表达尊敬的东西，如奖项、称号
senses.example: She brought honour to her school by winning the contest.
senses.exampleCN: 她赢得比赛，为学校争得了荣誉。
senses.why: What begins as a feeling can be pinned on the chest as a thing.
senses.whyCN: 尊敬从一种感受，变成一枚可以别在胸前的实体。

senses.title: The proud feeling of being respected
senses.definition: the proud and pleased feeling when you are given special respect
senses.definitionCN: 受到特殊礼遇时的自豪与喜悦
senses.example: It is a great honour to speak here today.
senses.exampleCN: 今天能在这里发言，我深感荣幸。
senses.why: When respect flows toward you, the feeling inside is honour.
senses.whyCN: 当尊敬流向你时，心里涌起的感受就是荣幸。

senses.title: To respect or keep a promise (verb)
senses.definition: to show respect for someone, or to do what you promised
senses.definitionCN: 对某人表示尊敬，或履行承诺
senses.example: The team honoured their promise to visit the old school.
senses.exampleCN: 球队履行了回访母校的承诺。
senses.why: A promise is treated like a flag: you raise it, and then you must keep it flying.
senses.whyCN: 承诺像旗帜：升起来之后，就必须让它一直飘着。

intro.en: Honour came through Old French onor from Latin honos, honour, the same root as honest.
intro.cn: honour 经古法语 onor 来自拉丁 honos「荣誉」，与 honest 同根。

items.en: Latin honos, later honor, meant public respect and official position.
items.cn: 拉丁 honos（后作 honor）指公众敬重与官职地位。

items.en: Old French onor carried the word into English after the Norman Conquest.
items.cn: 诺曼征服后，古法语 onor 把这个词带入英语。

items.en: Middle English spelled it honour under French influence; American English later cut the u.
items.cn: 受法语影响，中古英语拼作 honour；美式英语后来删去 u。

items.en: Modern English widened the verb: honour people, honour promises, honour the dead.
items.cn: 现代英语扩展了动词用法：尊敬人、信守承诺、缅怀逝者。

items.en: The same Latin root builds honest, honorary and honorarium.
items.cn: 同一拉丁词根还派生出 honest、honorary 与 honorarium。

note.en: Group one keeps the silent-h same-root family; group two keeps words for respect and glory.
note.cn: 第一组是 h 不发音的同根词族；第二组是表示尊敬与荣耀的近义词。

entries.definition: truthful and fair; the h is silent too
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「诚实的」，h 同样不发音

entries.definition: deserving honour and respect
entries.definitionCN: 同根形容词，义为「可敬的；光荣的」

entries.definition: shame; loss of respect
entries.definitionCN: 同根反义词，义为「耻辱；使蒙羞」

entries.definition: the feeling that someone is important and deserves care
entries.definitionCN: 尊重，强调把人当回事

entries.definition: fame and praise won by great deeds
entries.definitionCN: 荣耀，多指功业带来的名望

entries.definition: the feeling of being pleased with what you or your group has done
entries.definitionCN: 自豪感，强调为已得成就喜悦

normalIntro.en: Use the silent-h family and fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 用 h 不发音词族与固定搭配记住 honour。

normal.en: honour, honest, hour: three silent h words together
normal.cn: honour、honest、hour：三个 h 不发音的词打包记。

normal.en: in honour of = a party or name given to remember someone
normal.cn: in honour of＝为纪念某人而办活动、命名。

normal.en: honour a promise: keep the flag of your word flying
normal.cn: honour a promise：让承诺的旗帜继续飘着＝信守承诺。

normal.en: guest of honour is the most important guest
normal.cn: guest of honour＝最重要的客人＝主宾。

normal.en: American spelling honor drops the u
normal.cn: 美式拼写 honor 少一个 u，拼写比赛别记混。

abstract.en: Picture a medal pinned on a plain grey coat.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚别在灰色旧外套上的奖章——荣誉很轻，份量很重。

abstract.en: Picture a name carved higher than the rest on a school wall.
abstract.cn: 想象校墙上某个名字刻得比别的都高。

abstract.en: Feel the quiet of a hall when everyone rises at once.
abstract.cn: 感受全场起立时那一刻的安静——最庄重的尊敬。

examples.en: The bridge was named in honour of the old scientist.
examples.cn: 这座桥以那位老科学家的名字命名，以示纪念。

examples.en: It is an honour to represent my class in the contest.
examples.cn: 能代表班级参赛，我深感荣幸。

examples.en: A person of honour keeps a promise once it is made.
examples.cn: 讲荣誉的人一旦许诺就会信守。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「昂呐」——昂首挺胸接受众人呐（h）喊喝彩的名字，就是 honour（荣誉；尊敬）。

root: honour 经古法语 onor 来自拉丁 honos「荣誉」，与 honest 同根；h 不发音。英式拼 honour、美式拼 honor，派生 honourable、honorary 等。

sensesIntro.en: Honour runs from the respect in other eyes, to the prize on the chest, to the promise you keep.
sensesIntro.cn: honour 从他人眼中的敬意，到胸前的奖项，再到你必须信守的承诺，一脉贯通。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name lifted above the crowd
core.cn: 核心意象：被举到人群之上的名字

branches.en: the respect shown by others
branches.cn: 他人表达的敬重（义项 01）

branches.en: the prize that carries the respect
branches.cn: 承载敬意的奖项（义项 02）

branches.en: the warmth felt inside
branches.cn: 内心涌起的荣幸（义项 03）

branches.en: respect turned into action
branches.cn: 化为行动的尊敬（义项 04）

branches.en: keeping a promise brings honour
branches.cn: 信守承诺本身即是荣誉（义项 02 · 04）

intro.en: Honour heads a Latin family of respect with clear prefixes and suffixes.

latinIntro.en: Latin honos, honoris is the true ancestor; the family also builds honorary and honorarium.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 honos, honoris 是真正的祖先，词族还派生 honorary 与 honorarium。

an honourable member of the council

He chose death over dishonour.

an honest judge

Decorus builds decorum.

definition_zh: 希望；期望；希望的事；（动词）希望；但愿
definition_en: to want something to happen and think it can happen; the good thing that you want to happen
core_image: 黑夜里仍亮着的一根火柴：很小，但朝向光的方向
scene: 考卷发下来之前，她把铅笔盒攥得紧紧的，心里默默念着一定要过。I hope I pass the exam this time.
sceneCN: 这里 hope 是动词「希望；但愿」（第 1 个义项：盼望好事发生）；发卷前她心里默念希望能通过。

pos.zh: 希望；期望；被寄予希望的人或事

collocations.zh: 往最好处想；抱乐观期待
抱一线希望；明知无望仍存希望

derivatives.zh: hope + -ful（充满）→ 充满希望的
hopeful + -ly → 满怀希望地；但愿
hope + -less（无）→ 没有希望的；不擅长的
hopeless + -ness → 绝望

senses.title: To want something good to happen
senses.definition: to want something to happen and think that it may happen
senses.definitionCN: 盼望某事发生，并认为它有可能发生
senses.example: We hope the rain will stop before the picnic.
senses.exampleCN: 我们希望野餐前雨会停。
senses.why: Hope keeps one eye on the wish and one eye on the chance: it is wishing that feels possible.
senses.whyCN: 希望一眼盯着愿望、一眼盯着可能：是「觉得有可能实现的盼望」。

senses.title: The good thing wished for
senses.definition: the thing or person that people want and look forward to
senses.definitionCN: 人们盼望、期待的人或事物
senses.example: The young players are the hope of the team.
senses.exampleCN: 这些年轻队员是球队的希望。
senses.why: The feeling turns into a thing: what is hoped for becomes the hope itself.
senses.whyCN: 感受变成了实体：所盼望的对象本身就被称为「希望」。

senses.title: To say politely what you want
senses.definition: used to say politely what you want or intend, often to soften words
senses.definitionCN: 礼貌地表达愿望或打算，让语气更委婉
senses.example: I hope to see you again soon.
senses.exampleCN: 但愿很快能再见到你。
senses.why: Saying I hope instead of I want makes a request softer and kinder.
senses.whyCN: 用 I hope 代替 I want，请求听起来更温和有礼。

intro.en: Hope is an Old English word, hopian, of Germanic origin; its deeper root is uncertain.
intro.cn: hope 是古英语词 hopian，属日耳曼语源；更深的词根来源不确定。

items.en: Old English hopian meant to wish and to expect good things.
items.cn: 古英语 hopian 意为盼望、期待好事。

items.en: The word belongs to the Germanic family, though relatives outside English are few.
items.cn: 该词属日耳曼语族，但英语之外的同族词很少。

items.en: In Middle English hope worked as both verb and noun, as today.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，hope 与今天一样兼作动词和名词。

items.en: Modern English built the family hopeful, hopeless and hopefully.
items.cn: 现代英语造出 hopeful、hopeless、hopefully 一族。

items.en: The deeper root is not fully agreed on; scholars discuss several old guesses.
items.cn: 更深的词根尚无定论，学界对几种古老猜想仍有讨论。

note.en: Group one holds the hope family; group two holds words about wanting and expecting.
note.cn: 第一组是 hope 词族；第二组是表示愿望与期待的相关词。

entries.definition: feeling that good things may happen
entries.definitionCN: 同根形容词，义为「满怀希望的」

entries.definition: without hope, or very bad at something
entries.definitionCN: 同根反义词，义为「无望的；不擅长的」

entries.definition: it is to be hoped that; with hope
entries.definitionCN: 同根副词，义为「但愿；满怀希望地」

entries.definition: to want something that may not really be possible
entries.definitionCN: 但愿，所想之事未必可能实现

entries.definition: to think something will certainly happen
entries.definitionCN: 预料，认为多半会发生

entries.definition: to want something strongly
entries.definitionCN: 渴望，语气更强、更正式

normalIntro.en: Use the two opposite endings to fix the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用一对相反的后缀把 hope 记牢。

normal.en: hope + -ful = full of hope, hopeful
normal.cn: hope + -ful＝充满希望＝hopeful。

normal.en: hope + -less = no hope left, hopeless
normal.cn: hope + -less＝希望耗尽＝hopeless。

normal.en: past form hoped keeps only one p: she hoped
normal.cn: 过去式 hoped 只留一个 p：she hoped。

normal.en: hope for the best, prepare for the worst
normal.cn: hope for the best：往最好处盼，做最坏打算。

normal.en: a ray of hope is one thin line of light in the dark
normal.cn: a ray of hope 是黑暗里透出的一线光。

abstract.en: Picture a match struck in a dark room: small, but facing the light.
abstract.cn: 想象暗室里划亮的一根火柴：很小，但朝着光的方向。

abstract.en: Picture seeds under snow: nothing shows, yet spring is counted on.
abstract.cn: 想象雪下的种子：什么也看不见，人们却已在数着春天。

abstract.en: Feel hope as a hand half open: not grabbing, not letting go.
abstract.cn: 把希望感受成半开的手：既不抓紧，也不松开。

examples.en: Doctors never give up hope while the patient still fights.
examples.cn: 只要病人还在坚持，医生就不放弃希望。

examples.en: There is still a ray of hope for the lost climbers.
examples.cn: 失踪的登山者仍有一线生机。

examples.en: She hoped quietly that her name would be on the list.
examples.cn: 她默默希望名单上有自己的名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「厚盼」——心里厚厚地装着一个盼头，就是 hope（希望）。

root: hope 来自古英语 hopian「盼望」，属日耳曼本族词，英语之外同族词稀少，更深词根来源不确定；派生 hopeful、hopeless 等。

sensesIntro.en: Hope moves from the wishing mind, to the wished-for thing, to polite wishes in speech.
sensesIntro.cn: hope 从盼望的心情，到被盼望的对象，再到言语中委婉的意愿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small light still facing the dawn
core.cn: 核心意象：仍朝着黎明的一豆光亮

branches.en: the wish that feels possible
branches.cn: 觉得有可能实现的愿望（义项 01）

branches.en: the person or thing wished for
branches.cn: 被寄予期望的人或事（义项 02）

branches.en: the softening word in speech
branches.cn: 言语中让语气变软的词（义项 03）

branches.en: I hope is kinder than I want
branches.cn: I hope 比 I want 更客气（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: young players called the hope of a team
branches.cn: 被称为全队希望的年轻队员（义项 02）

intro.en: Hope is a short native verb whose two endings point in opposite directions.
intro.cn: hope 是简短的本族动词，两个后缀指向相反的方向。

latinIntro.en: Latin sperare is the classical verb of hoping; it builds despair and desperate.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sperare（盼望）是古典对照动词，派生出 despair 与 desperate。

items.example: I hope the bus is not late.
a hopeful young singer
items.exampleCN: 一位满怀希望的歌坛新秀

items.meaning: without hope; very bad at something
items.example: I am hopeless at drawing.
Hopefully, the rain will stop.

items.meaningCN: hope 的现在分词（去 e 加 ing）
items.example: Hoping for a reply, he checked the mailbox again.
items.exampleCN: 盼着回信，他又查了一次邮箱。

items.meaning: to keep hoping with little reason
items.example: They hoped against hope for news.
items.exampleCN: 他们明知无望仍盼着消息。

items.meaning: to want what may not be possible
items.example: Wish me luck!
Sperare builds despair and desperate.
items.exampleCN: sperare 派生出 despair 与 desperate。

definition_zh: 马；骑兵；体操鞍马；锯木架；晾衣架；马力（口语）
definition_en: a large domesticated animal used for riding and draught; cavalry; a frame or device named after the animal; a unit of engine power
core_image: 一匹马在草地上奔跑，鬃毛扬起；旁边是一个木制锯木架，四条腿撑开
scene: 草场上马蹄翻起泥点，鬃毛被风扯向后方，骑手压低身体；场边摆着四条腿撑开的木架。The horse carried the rider across the flooded ford without hesitation.
sceneCN: 这里指「用于骑乘的马」（第 1 个义项：马这种动物）；句意为这匹马毫不犹豫地把骑手驮过漫水的浅滩。

pos.zh: 马；骑兵；体操鞍马；锯木架；晾衣架
胡闹（仅用于短语 horse around）

collocations.zh: 黑马；出人意料的竞争者

derivatives.zh: horse + man（人）→ 骑马者；马术师
horseman + -ship（技艺、身份）→ 马术（语义偏移：从人转为技艺）
horse + back（背）→ 马背；骑马地
horse + drawn（被拉的）→ 马拉的
horse + hair（毛）→ 马毛；马鬃毛（语义偏移：指制刷与制弓的材料）
horse + power（动力）→ 马力（语义偏移：由动物力转为工程计量单位）
horse + play（玩耍）→ 嬉闹；粗野的胡闹（语义偏移：像马一样撒欢）

senses.title: The riding and draught animal
senses.definition: a large domesticated mammal with hooves and a mane, used for riding, racing and pulling loads
senses.definitionCN: 一种有蹄与鬃毛的大型家养哺乳动物，用于骑乘、赛马与拉载
senses.example: The horse stood still while the saddle was tightened.
senses.exampleCN: 紧鞍带时那匹马站着一动不动。
senses.why: The animal is the core sense, and its speed and strength are the source of every derived use.
senses.whyCN: 动物本身是核心义，它的速度与力量是所有引申用法的源头。

senses.title: Horses as a kind
senses.definition: the species Equus caballus considered collectively
senses.definitionCN: 作为一个物种整体看待的马
senses.example: Horses were reintroduced to the steppe after a long absence.
senses.exampleCN: 马在长期缺席之后被重新引入草原。
senses.why: A countable animal also names its whole kind, especially in history and biology.
senses.whyCN: 可数动物也能命名整个种类，尤见于历史与生物学。

senses.title: Cavalry soldiers
senses.definition: soldiers who fight on horseback, treated as a branch of an army
senses.definitionCN: 骑马作战的士兵，作为军队的一个兵种看待
senses.example: The horse broke the infantry line at dusk.
senses.exampleCN: 骑兵在黄昏突破了步兵阵线。
senses.why: Metonymy replaces the rider with the mount, so a whole military branch is called horse.
senses.whyCN: 转喻用坐骑替代骑手，于是整个兵种被称为 horse。

senses.title: A gymnastic vaulting horse
senses.definition: a padded apparatus that gymnasts vault over or swing on
senses.definitionCN: 体操运动员翻越或支撑摆动的软包器械
senses.example: She scored highest on the horse.
senses.exampleCN: 她在鞍马上得分最高。
senses.why: The apparatus inherited the animal's shape, a padded body on four legs, and kept its name.
senses.whyCN: 这种器械继承了动物的形状——四条腿撑着一个软包躯体，并保留了它的名字。

senses.title: A sawhorse
senses.definition: a wooden trestle with four legs used to support timber while it is cut
senses.definitionCN: 四条腿的木支架，锯木材时用来承托
senses.example: The plank rested on two sawhorses.
senses.exampleCN: 木板搁在两个锯木架上。
senses.why: Any four-legged support looks like a standing horse, so the animal's name moved to workshop furniture.
senses.whyCN: 任何四条腿的支架都像一匹站立的马，于是动物之名移到作坊家具上。

senses.title: A clothes horse
senses.definition: a frame for hanging or drying clothes indoors
senses.definitionCN: 室内挂晾衣物的框架
senses.example: The laundry filled the clothes horse by noon.
senses.exampleCN: 中午时晾衣架已经挂满了衣物。
senses.why: The frame is another four-legged stand, and the same image spread from the yard to the laundry.
senses.whyCN: 这又是一个四条腿的架子，同一意象从院子扩展到洗衣房。

senses.title: A unit of engine power
senses.definition: a conventional unit of power originally based on the work a draught horse could do
senses.definitionCN: 一种传统功率单位，最初以役马能做的功为基准
senses.example: The old engine produced forty horsepower.
senses.exampleCN: 这台旧发动机输出四十马力。
senses.why: Engineers needed a familiar yardstick, so one horse's output became a unit for machines.
senses.whyCN: 工程师需要一个熟悉的尺子，于是以一匹马的输出作为机器的单位。

senses.title: To fool around
senses.definition: to behave noisily or irresponsibly, used in the phrase horse around
senses.definitionCN: 喧闹或不负责地胡来，用于短语 horse around
senses.example: The boys horsed around until the teacher arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们一直胡闹到老师来。
senses.why: A loose horse galloping without purpose supplies the image of uncontrolled play.
senses.whyCN: 一匹脱缰的马无目的地奔跑，提供了「失控玩耍」的意象。

intro.en: Horse goes back to Old English hors, from Proto-Germanic hrossa, from a root generally connected with the idea of running. Latin currere, to run, belongs to the same old root. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: horse 可上溯到古英语 hors，来自原始日耳曼语 hrossa，其词根一般认为与「奔跑」有关。拉丁 currere「跑」属于同一古老词根。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hors named the animal in Old English and also stood for cavalry, a use English keeps in the phrase horse and foot.
items.cn: hors 在古英语中命名这种动物，也指骑兵，英语在短语 horse and foot 中保留了这一用法。

items.en: The Germanic form hrossa is reconstructed from English, German and Dutch evidence rather than recorded directly.
items.cn: 日耳曼形式 hrossa 是由英语、德语与荷兰语证据重构的，而非直接记录。

items.en: The word is generally connected with a root meaning to run, the same source as Latin currere and cursus.
items.cn: 这个词一般认为与表示「跑」的词根有关，与拉丁 currere 和 cursus 同源。

items.en: Latin currere, to run, and cursus, a course, come from the same old root, which is why they are useful relatives for the English word.
items.cn: 拉丁 currere「跑」与 cursus「行程」来自同一古老词根，因此它们是这个英语词的有用同族。

items.en: From the sixteenth century four-legged stands took the name, and from the eighteenth the animal's work rate became horsepower.
items.cn: 十六世纪起四条腿的支架取得这个名字；十八世纪起，动物的做功速率变成马力。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the Indo-European form is reconstructed, and the exact relation between hrossa and currere is not demonstrated in detail.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：印欧形式属重构，hrossa 与 currere 的确切关系也没有得到详细证明。

note.en: Group one holds horse compounds that are easily mistaken for the animal; group two holds the separate words for horses by sex, size and use.
note.cn: 第一组是由 horse 构成、易被误当成动物本身的复合词；第二组是按性别、体型与用途区分马的独立词。

entries.definition: A person who rides or manages horses; it is the human agent, not the animal.
entries.definitionCN: 骑马或管理马的人；它是人的施动者，不是动物。

entries.definition: The back of a horse, or the act of riding; it names a place or posture, not the animal.
entries.definitionCN: 马背，或骑马的状态；它命名位置或姿势，不是动物。

entries.definition: A unit of power based on a horse's work rate; it is a measurement, not a horse.
entries.definitionCN: 以马的工作速率为基础的功率单位；它是计量，不是马。

entries.definition: An adult female horse; horse names the kind, mare names the sex.
entries.definitionCN: 成年母马；horse 命名种类，mare 命名性别。

entries.definition: An adult uncastrated male horse; it is a sex class within the species.
entries.definitionCN: 成年未阉割的公马；它是物种内的性别等级。

entries.definition: A small horse breed, usually under a fixed height; it is a size class, not a separate species.
entries.definitionCN: 体型较小的马品种，通常低于规定高度；它是体型等级，不是独立物种。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Old English hors is connected with running, the same root as Latin currere.
normal.cn: 古英语 hors 与奔跑有关，与拉丁 currere 同根。

normal.en: The family runs horse, horseman, horseback, horsepower, horsehair, horseplay.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 horse、horseman、horseback、horsepower、horsehair、horseplay。

normal.en: Fixed phrases split the uses: ride a horse, horse racing, horse-drawn.
normal.cn: 固定搭配区分用法：骑马、赛马、马拉的。

normal.en: Four-legged stands keep the animal's shape: sawhorse and clothes horse.
normal.cn: 四条腿的支架保留了动物的形状：锯木架与晾衣架。

normal.en: Cavalry is simply horse in military writing, as in horse and foot.
normal.cn: 在军事文本中骑兵就是 horse，如 horse and foot。

abstract.en: Picture a body of muscle that can be read as speed, rank, furniture or engine power.
abstract.cn: 想象一具肌肉之躯，可以被读成速度、军阶、家具或发动机功率。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden trestle standing in a yard, waiting to be ridden by a plank.
abstract.cn: 想象一个木架站在院子里，等着被一块木板「骑」。

abstract.en: Picture a child galloping through a kitchen until the table shakes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子跑过厨房，直到桌子都晃起来。

examples.en: The horse refused the jump at the last stride.
examples.cn: 那匹马在最后一步拒绝起跳。

examples.en: Cavalry horses were kept in the rear until the signal.
examples.cn: 骑兵的马留在后方，直到信号出现。

examples.en: He would not stop horsing around during the rehearsal.
examples.cn: 排演时他不停地胡闹。

dict_mnemonic.text: horse 本义是马，因马有四条腿，四腿木架也叫 horse；因马能出力，功率单位叫 horsepower；骑兵也用 horse 代称。

root: 古英语 hors「马」→ 原始日耳曼 hrossa；一般认为与表示「奔跑」的词根有关，拉丁 currere「跑」与 cursus「行程」同源，更早形式属重构。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one animal: the mount, the species, the cavalry, two kinds of frame, a unit of power and a way of playing.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一种动物展开：坐骑、物种、骑兵、两种架子、功率单位与一种玩闹方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a running animal and a four-legged wooden stand share one outline, and the same outline appears in a gymnasium and a laundry.
core.cn: 核心意象：奔跑的动物与四条腿的木架共享一个轮廓，同一轮廓又出现在体操房与洗衣房。

branches.en: THE ANIMAL AND THE KIND: one horse and the species it belongs to.
branches.cn: 动物与种类：一匹马与它所属的物种。

branches.en: THE WAR MOUNT: the rider is replaced by the horse in military speech.
branches.cn: 战马：军事语言中用马替代骑手。

branches.en: THE GYMNASTIC FRAME: a padded body on four legs keeps the shape.
branches.cn: 体操器械：四条腿上的软包躯体保留了形状。

branches.en: THE WORK FRAME: sawhorse and clothes horse are the animal turned furniture.
branches.cn: 工作架：锯木架与晾衣架是动物变成家具。

branches.en: POWER AND PLAY: the horse's work rate becomes a unit, and its loose gallop becomes a game.
branches.cn: 力与玩：马的工作速率变成单位，脱缰奔跑变成游戏。

intro.en: Horse is a native Germanic noun, and its large compound family is built from English elements rather than Latin suffixes.
intro.cn: horse 是日耳曼本族名词，其庞大的复合词族由英语成分而非拉丁后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word is its direct ancestor, but Latin currere and cursus share the old running root; Latin equus names the animal from a different root and is given for contrast.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁词是它的直接祖先，但拉丁 currere 与 cursus 共享古老的「跑」词根；拉丁 equus 从另一词根命名这种动物，列在此处作对照。

items.example: The Old English noun already had both senses.
items.exampleCN: 这个古英语名词已有两种意义。

items.structure: horse (English noun, from Old English hors)
items.example: The horse cleared the ditch easily.
The horseman rode ahead of the column.
Her horsemanship impressed the judges.
items.exampleCN: 她的马术让评委印象深刻。

items.meaning: the back of a horse; riding
items.example: They travelled on horseback.
A horse-drawn cart blocked the lane.

items.meaning: hair from a horse's mane or tail
items.example: The bow was strung with horsehair.
The pump needs ten horsepower.
Horseplay broke the window.

definition_zh: 医院；住院处
definition_en: a place where sick or injured people are given medical treatment by doctors and nurses
core_image: 挂着白床单的安静走廊：白天有人推着轮椅经过，夜里只剩仪器的小灯
scene: 放学路过街角，救护车正停在诊所隔壁的大白楼前。Grandma stayed in the hospital for a week after her fall.
sceneCN: 这里 hospital 是「医院」（第 1 个义项：治病的地方）；奶奶摔倒后在那里住了一周。

collocations.zh: 去医院（看病；英式指住院）

derivatives.zh: hospital + -ity → 好客；殷勤招待（同根词，源于「接待客人」）
hospital + -able → 好客的；热情接待的
同根词 → 主人；主持人（接待者）
同根词 → 青年旅舍；招待所

senses.title: A place for treating the sick
senses.definition: a building where doctors and nurses treat sick or injured people
senses.definitionCN: 医生护士为病人和伤者治疗的建筑
senses.example: The new hospital has a large garden for patients.
senses.exampleCN: 新医院有一个供病人休养的大花园。
senses.why: The core sense is the house that receives those who cannot stay home.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是「接待无法留在家中的人的那栋房子」。

senses.title: Being a patient there
senses.definition: the time a person spends in hospital as a patient
senses.definitionCN: 一个人作为病人在医院度过的时段
senses.example: His hospital after the accident lasted almost a month.
senses.exampleCN: 事故后他住院将近一个月。
senses.why: English uses the building’s name for the stay itself: in hospital means inside its care.
senses.whyCN: 英语用建筑名指住院本身：in hospital 即「处于它的照护之中」。

senses.title: A charitable institution in history
senses.definition: in older use, a house that gave care and shelter to the poor, old or travellers
senses.definitionCN: 旧时指收容照顾穷人、老人或旅者的机构
senses.example: An old hospital for travellers stood by the mountain road.
senses.exampleCN: 山道旁曾有一座收留旅者的慈善院。
senses.why: Before modern medicine, the word meant any house of care, not only a place for the sick.
senses.whyCN: 在现代医学出现之前，该词泛指任何提供照护的房子，不只为病人服务。

intro.en: Hospital comes from Latin hospitalis, of a guest, from hospes, meaning guest and host at once.
intro.cn: hospital 来自拉丁 hospitalis「客人的」，其词根 hospes 同时表示「客人」与「主人」。

items.en: Latin hospes meant both guest and host: the one received and the one receiving.
items.cn: 拉丁 hospes 兼指客人与主人：被接待者与接待者。

items.en: The adjective hospitalis meant of a guest or of hospitality; the noun hospitalia meant guest rooms.
items.cn: 形容词 hospitalis 意为「与客人有关的」，名词 hospitalia 指客房。

items.en: Old French hospital named houses run by the Church to shelter the poor and the sick.
items.cn: 古法语 hospital 指教会开办、收容贫病者的院舍。

items.en: Middle English borrowed hospital in the thirteenth century with this charitable sense.
items.cn: 中古英语十三世纪借入 hospital，取其慈善义。

items.en: Modern English narrowed the word to medical care, while the old guest sense survives in host, hostel and hospitality.
items.cn: 现代英语把词义收窄到医疗，古老的「待客」义留在 host、hostel、hospitality 中。

note.en: Group one holds the Latin guest family; group two holds places connected with healing.
note.cn: 第一组是拉丁「客人」词族；第二组是与医治相关的场所词。

entries.definition: a cheap place for travellers to sleep
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「旅舍」，保留待客旧义

entries.definition: friendly welcome given to guests
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「好客；款待」

entries.definition: kind and welcoming to guests
entries.definitionCN: 同根形容词，义为「好客的」

entries.definition: a small place for medical advice and treatment, not for staying
entries.definitionCN: 诊所，可看病但不住院

entries.definition: a large room in a hospital with several beds
entries.definitionCN: 病房，医院里的大房间

entries.definition: a place for long rest and treatment
entries.definitionCN: 疗养院，以休养为主

normalIntro.en: Use the guest root family to build the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用「客人」词根家族来建这个词。

normal.en: hospes means guest and host: a hospital hosts its guests
normal.cn: hospes 兼指客人与主人：医院就是接待「客人」的主人家。

normal.en: hospital + -ity = hospitality, welcoming guests warmly
normal.cn: hospital + -ity＝hospitality，热情待客。

normal.en: host, hostel, hospital all grew from one Latin root
normal.cn: host、hostel、hospital 都长自同一拉丁词根。

normal.en: in hospital without the: British English means as a patient
normal.cn: 英式英语说 in hospital 不加 the：作为病人在住院。

normal.en: children’s hospital: the hospital for children
normal.cn: children’s hospital＝儿童医院。

abstract.en: Picture a doorway that never closes: anyone carried in is received.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇从不关上的门：被抬进来的人都会被接待。

abstract.en: Picture rows of beds, each one with its own small light.
abstract.cn: 想象一排排病床，每张床亮着一盏小灯。

abstract.en: Feel the quiet of a ward after ten at night.
abstract.cn: 感受晚上十点后病房的安静。

examples.en: The injured player was taken to hospital at once.
examples.cn: 受伤的球员被立刻送往医院。

examples.en: She visits her uncle in hospital every Sunday.
examples.cn: 她每周日去探望住院的叔叔。

examples.en: The town built a new children’s hospital last year.
examples.cn: 镇上去年新建了一座儿童医院。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「好死皮特」——好心的皮特开诊所收留病人，那栋白楼就是 hospital（医院）。

root: hospital 来自拉丁 hospitalis「与客人有关的」，词根 hospes 兼指客人、主人；同根词有 host、hostel、hospitality，均保留「接待」的古义。

sensesIntro.en: From a house that receives guests, hospital narrowed to the house that receives the sick.
sensesIntro.cn: hospital 从「接待客人的房子」收窄为「接待病人的房子」，住院义由建筑名引申而来。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a house that receives those who cannot stay home
core.cn: 核心意象：收留无法留在家中者的那栋房子

branches.en: the building of medical care
branches.cn: 实施医疗的建筑（义项 01）

branches.en: the stay inside its care
branches.cn: 处在它照护下的时段（义项 02）

branches.en: the older shelter for anyone in need
branches.cn: 旧时收容一切的院舍（义项 03）

branches.cn: 先有照护，后有医学（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: the building name stands for the stay
branches.cn: 建筑名代指住院本身（义项 01 · 02）

intro.en: Hospital belongs to the Latin guest family, one of the most productive roots in English.
intro.cn: hospital 属于拉丁「客人」词族，是英语里能产性最高的词根之一。

latinIntro.en: Latin hospes, hospit-, guest and host, is the true ancestor of the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 hospes（词干 hospit-，客人、主人）是整个词族的真正祖先。

items.example: Hospes carries both roles in one word.
items.exampleCN: hospes 一个词兼含两种角色。

items.example: Hospitalis gave hospital its shape.

items.meaning: a house of care for the sick

Their hospitality was famous in the town.
items.exampleCN: 他们的好客在镇上出名。

items.example: a hospitable old inn
The host poured tea for everyone.
They stayed in a youth hostel.
Also gives hostile, originally of strangers.
items.exampleCN: 还派生 hostile，本义与陌生人有关。

definition_zh: 热的；炎热的；辣的；热烈的；（口语）热门的
definition_en: having a high temperature, or a burning taste, or full of excitement and attention
core_image: 一口刚出锅的锅：烫手、冒气、红亮，谁都躲不开它的温度
scene: 刚出锅的饺子直冒热气，他伸手去拿被烫了回来。Be careful! The soup is very hot.
sceneCN: 这里 hot 是「热的；烫的」（第 1 个义项：温度高）；刚端上桌的汤温度很高，所以要小心。

pos.zh: 热的；炎热的；辣的；热烈的
热切地（口语，如 blow hot and cold）

collocations.zh: 坐上火炉；处于被质询的境地

derivatives.zh: hot 的名词与动词形式 → 热；高温；加热
heat + -ed → 加热的；激烈的（如 heated discussion）
hot 的比较级，双写 t → 更热的
hot + head → 性子急躁的人（鲁莽冲动者）

senses.title: Having a high temperature
senses.definition: having a high temperature, often too hot to touch comfortably
senses.definitionCN: 温度很高，常烫得不能直接触碰
senses.example: The kettle makes the water hot for tea.
senses.exampleCN: 水壶把水烧得很热，好泡茶。
senses.why: The core sense is measured in degrees: heat you can feel on the skin.
senses.whyCN: 核心义以温度计量：皮肤能感觉到的热。

senses.title: Burning to the taste
senses.definition: having a strong burning taste from pepper or spice
senses.definitionCN: 由辣椒或香料带来的强烈灼口感
senses.example: The hot sauce made his eyes water.
senses.exampleCN: 辣酱辣得他直流眼泪。
senses.why: The tongue burns as if touched by fire: taste borrows the language of temperature.
senses.whyCN: 舌头像被火烫到：味觉借用了温度的语言。

senses.title: Full of excitement and attention
senses.definition: full of strong feeling, interest or attention
senses.definitionCN: 充满强烈情绪、关注或兴趣的
senses.example: The new phone is the hottest topic in school.
senses.exampleCN: 那款新手机是学校里最热门的话题。
senses.why: Interest raises the temperature of a topic, so a crowd’s attention becomes heat.
senses.whyCN: 关注会抬高话题的「温度」，人群的热情就成了热。

intro.en: Hot is an Old English adjective, hat, from the same root as the verb hata, to be hot.
intro.cn: hot 是古英语形容词 hat，与动词 hata（发烫）同根。

items.en: Old English hat meant hot to the touch and hot to the taste alike.
items.cn: 古英语 hat 兼指触觉的热与味觉的辣。

items.en: The root is Germanic: German heiss and Dutch heet are close relatives.
items.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族：德语 heiss、荷兰语 heet 是近亲。

items.en: In Middle English the spelling shortened to hot, and the spicy sense stayed common.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写缩为 hot，「辣」义沿用至今。

items.en: Modern English added figurative uses: hot news, hot seat, blow hot and cold.
items.cn: 现代英语发展出比喻用法：hot news、hot seat、blow hot and cold。

items.en: The connection to the verb hate is a false guess; the real deeper root is reconstructed only.
items.cn: 它与动词 hate（恨）同源是误传；真正的更深词根只有重构形式。

note.en: Group one keeps the temperature family; group two keeps other words for heat and spiciness.
note.cn: 第一组是温度词族；第二组是表示热与辣的其他说法。

entries.definition: the noun and verb of hotness
entries.definitionCN: hot 的名词与动词形式，义为「热；加热」

entries.definition: a person who acts too quickly in anger
entries.definitionCN: hot + head 复合，义为「急性子」

entries.definition: made hot; full of anger in a discussion
entries.definitionCN: 同族形容词，义为「加热的；激烈的」

entries.definition: pleasantly hot, not burning
entries.definitionCN: 温暖的，比 hot 程度低

entries.definition: tasting of strong spices
entries.definitionCN: 辛辣的，强调香料味道

entries.definition: very hot, as if on fire
entries.definitionCN: 滚烫的，如着火一般

normalIntro.en: Use the double-t spelling rule and the temperature family.
normalIntro.cn: 用双写 t 的拼写规则与温度词族记 hot。

normal.en: hot + ter, hot + test: double the t
normal.cn: 比较级 hotter、最高级 hottest：双写 t 再加词尾。

normal.en: hot tea and hot soup: temperature you can feel
normal.cn: hot tea 与 hot soup：皮肤能感到的温度。

normal.en: hot chilli: the burning taste
normal.cn: hot chilli：灼口的辣味。

normal.en: a hot topic is a topic with rising temperature
normal.cn: a hot topic＝温度升高的话题＝热门话题。

normal.en: blow hot and cold: one breath two temperatures
normal.cn: blow hot and cold：一口气吹出两种温度＝摇摆不定。

abstract.en: Picture steam rising from a bowl you cannot hold yet.
abstract.cn: 想象一碗冒着白汽、你还端不住的汤——烫。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd slowly crowding toward one booth.
abstract.cn: 想象人群慢慢涌向同一个摊位——热门。

abstract.en: Feel the word as a red colour on the thermometer.
abstract.cn: 把这个词感受成温度计上的一格红色。

examples.en: The tea is too hot to drink right now.
examples.cn: 这茶太烫了，现在还不能喝。

examples.en: Sichuan food is famous for being hot and spicy.
examples.cn: 川菜以麻辣闻名。

examples.en: July is the hottest month here.
examples.cn: 七月是这里最热的月份。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「火烫」——hot 读起来像「火烫」的快说：又热又辣，温度计爆表。

root: hot 来自古英语 hat「热的」，与古英语动词 hata「发烫」同根，属日耳曼本族词，德语 heiss、荷兰语 heet 同源；与 hate 无关。

sensesIntro.en: One word measures fire on the skin, fire on the tongue and fire in the crowd.
sensesIntro.cn: hot 一个词量出三种热：皮肤上的烫、舌尖上的辣、人群里的热。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rising temperature you cannot ignore
core.cn: 核心意象：无法忽视的升高的温度

branches.en: the touch of fire
branches.cn: 皮肤感到的热（义项 01）

branches.en: the fire on the tongue
branches.cn: 舌尖上的火（义项 02）

branches.en: the fire of the crowd
branches.cn: 人群中的火（义项 03）

branches.en: burning taste and burning interest share heat
branches.cn: 辣味与热度共用一份「烫」（义项 02 · 03）

branches.en: hotter and hottest climb the scale
branches.cn: hotter、hottest 沿温度梯爬升（义项 01）

intro.en: Hot is a short adjective with a small but very active family.
intro.cn: hot 是短小形容词，词族不大却非常活跃。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 calidus（热的）是古典对照词，派生 calorie 与 caldron。

items.example: The sand was too hot to walk on.
This summer is hotter than last one.
the hottest day of the year
Heat the milk slowly.

A hothead often regrets his words.
items.exampleCN: 急性子常为自己的话后悔。

items.meaning: in an eager or angry way
