Calidus builds calorie.

definition_zh: 旅馆；饭店；宾馆
definition_en: a building where travellers can pay to sleep and eat for a short time
core_image: 亮着满窗灯光的高楼：给不回家的人一扇今晚的门
scene: 旅行团拖着行李走进街口那栋亮着灯的大楼。We booked a hotel near the station for two nights.
sceneCN: 这里 hotel 是「旅馆」（第 1 个义项：供旅客付费住宿的地方）；我们在车站附近订了两晚的房间。

derivatives.zh: hotel + -ier（经营者）→ 旅馆老板；酒店经营者
motor + hotel 缩合 → 汽车旅馆
同根词 → 旅舍；青年旅舍（更简朴）

senses.title: A place where travellers pay to stay
senses.definition: a building with rooms that travellers rent for a short stay
senses.definitionCN: 备有客房、供旅客短期租住的建筑
senses.example: The hotel serves breakfast from seven to ten.
senses.exampleCN: 旅馆从七点到十点供应早餐。
senses.why: The core sense is a house that receives strangers and asks for payment.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是接待陌生人并收取费用的房子。

senses.title: A large restaurant or public house in older use
senses.titleCN: 大饭店；公共娱乐场所（旧义）
senses.definition: in older or larger use, a big establishment offering meals and rooms together
senses.definitionCN: 旧时或大型场合指同时供餐供宿的大型场所
senses.example: The grand hotel by the lake has a famous dining hall.
senses.exampleCN: 湖畔那座大酒店有一个有名的宴会厅。
senses.why: A big hotel is a small town: sleeping, eating and meeting in one roof.
senses.whyCN: 大酒店像一个小社会：住宿、餐饮、聚会同在一顶屋檐下。

senses.title: The holiday and travel industry
senses.definition: the business of providing rooms and meals for travellers
senses.definitionCN: 为旅客提供食宿的行业
senses.example: She has worked in the hotel industry for ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 她在酒店业工作了十年。
senses.why: The building’s name grew into the name of the whole trade.
senses.whyCN: 建筑之名扩展成整个行业的名称。

intro.en: Hotel came from French hotel, from Latin hospitale, the same guest root as hospital.
intro.cn: hotel 来自法语 hotel，源头是拉丁 hospitale，与 hospital 同属「客人」词根。

items.en: Latin hospitale, later hospitium, meant a place of reception for guests.
items.cn: 拉丁 hospitale（后作 hospitium）指接待客人的场所。

items.en: Old French hostel named a lodging house, and the s later dropped in French hotel.
items.cn: 古法语 hostel 指旅舍；法语后来丢掉 s 变成 hotel。

items.en: The new French form hotel named noble town houses first, then lodging houses.
items.cn: 法语新形 hotel 先指贵族城宅，后指旅舍。

items.en: English kept hostel with its s, and borrowed hotel in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 英语保留带 s 的 hostel，十八世纪再借入 hotel。

items.en: Modern English paired the two: hostel is simple, hotel is paid and comfortable.
items.cn: 现代英语中两者分工：hostel 简朴，hotel 收费且舒适。

note.en: Group one shows the guest-root family; group two shows places where travellers sleep.
note.cn: 第一组是「客人」词根家族；第二组是旅客过夜的相关场所。

entries.definition: a simple and cheap lodging for young travellers
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「旅舍」，简朴便宜

entries.definition: a place of care for the sick, not for travellers
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「医院」，收容对象不同

entries.definition: a person who owns or manages a hotel
entries.definitionCN: 同根派生词，义为「酒店经营者」

entries.definition: a small old-style house offering rooms and drinks
entries.definitionCN: 小客栈，旧式小馆，可宿可饮

entries.definition: a hotel for drivers, rooms facing the car park
entries.definitionCN: 汽车旅馆，专为驾车旅客设

entries.definition: a private house renting rooms to guests
entries.definitionCN: 家庭旅馆，民宅改客房

normalIntro.en: Use the guest root and the paired words.
normalIntro.cn: 用「客人」词根与成对词记 hotel。

normal.en: hotel and hospital share one root: both receive guests
normal.cn: hotel 与 hospital 同根：都是接待「客人」的房子。

normal.en: motel = motor + hotel, a hotel for cars
normal.cn: motel＝motor + hotel 的缩合＝给车住的旅馆。

normal.en: hostel is the backpacker, hotel is the traveller
normal.cn: hostel 属背包客，hotel 属（付钱的）旅行者。

normal.en: check into a hotel: the front desk hands you a key
normal.cn: check into a hotel：前台递来钥匙＝办入住。

normal.en: five-star hotel: five stars for five kinds of comfort
normal.cn: 五星级酒店：五颗星代表五种舒适。

abstract.en: Picture a lit window in a strange town that answers your tiredness.
abstract.cn: 想象陌生城镇里一扇亮灯的窗，回应你的疲惫。

abstract.en: Picture a row of identical doors, each hiding a different night.
abstract.cn: 想象一排相同的房门，每扇门后藏着不同的一夜。

abstract.en: Feel the lobby clock and the suitcase wheels at midnight.
abstract.cn: 感受午夜的酒店大堂挂钟与行李箱轮子的声响。

examples.en: The hotel was fully booked during the holiday week.
examples.cn: 假期那一周，旅馆房间全部订满。

examples.en: Breakfast at the hotel starts at seven.
examples.cn: 旅馆的早餐七点开始供应。

examples.en: They opened a small hotel beside the lake road.
examples.cn: 他们在湖边公路旁开了一家小旅馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「候图」——出门在外的人都在门口候着一张「图」安稳的床，那栋楼就是 hotel（旅馆）。

root: hotel 经法语 hotel（hostel 失去 s）来自拉丁 hospitale「接待客人的场所」，与 hospital、hostel 同根；英语于十八世纪借入现代用法。

sensesIntro.en: From guest rooms in Latin times to a whole industry, hotel keeps the old idea of receiving strangers.
sensesIntro.cn: hotel 从古代的客房一路扩展为整个行业，始终保留「接待陌生人」的古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lit door for travellers far from home

branches.en: the paid room for a night

branches.en: meals and rooms under one roof
branches.cn: 同一屋檐下的食宿（义项 02）

branches.cn: 一栋楼撑起一个行业（义项 01 · 03）

pos.zh: 小时；钟头；时刻（复数指作息时间）

collocations.zh: 在任意（不合时宜的）时刻

derivatives.zh: hour + -ly → 每小时一次的；按小时计的
hour + glass → 沙漏（一小时的玻璃计时器）
hour + hand → （钟表的）时针

senses.title: A period of sixty minutes
senses.definition: a fixed period of sixty minutes used for measuring time
senses.definitionCN: 固定为六十分钟的计时单位
senses.example: We waited almost an hour for the last bus.
senses.exampleCN: 我们等末班车等了将近一小时。
senses.why: The core sense is one full circle of the long hand on the clock face.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是长针在钟面上走满一整圈。

senses.title: A fixed time of day
senses.definition: a particular time of day fixed by habit or rule
senses.definitionCN: 由习惯或规定确定的某一天中的时间
senses.example: Lunch hour is the quietest time in this office.
senses.exampleCN: 午餐时刻是这间办公室最安静的时候。
senses.why: One circle of the clock names the moment it points to: the hour becomes a place in the day.
senses.whyCN: 钟面的一圈同时指出了它停下的位置：小时变成了「一天中的某个地点」。

senses.title: The working or opening times
senses.titleCN: 作息时间；营业时间（复数）
senses.definition: the times when a shop, office or person works or opens (used in the plural)
senses.definitionCN: 商店、机构或个人工作、营业的时间（用复数）
senses.example: The shop’s opening hours are from nine to nine.
senses.exampleCN: 这家商店的营业时间是从九点到九点。
senses.why: The day is divided into named hours, and the set of those names becomes a timetable.
senses.whyCN: 一天被分成有名字的钟点，这些名字的总和就成了作息表。

intro.en: Hour came through Old French houre from Latin hora, an hour, which Greek took from the East.
intro.cn: hour 经古法语 houre 来自拉丁 hora「小时」，希腊语的 hora 又借自东方。

items.en: Greek hora meant season and hour: a division of the day as well as a time of year.
items.cn: 希腊语 hora 兼指时节与钟点：既是时段，也是季节。

items.en: Latin hora meant the twelfth part of daylight, fixed later as sixty minutes.
items.cn: 拉丁 hora 原指白昼的十二分之一，后固定为六十分钟。

items.en: Old French houre carried the word into English after the Conquest.
items.cn: 诺曼征服后，古法语 houre 把该词带入英语。

items.en: Middle English spelled it houre or our; the h began to be pronounced later.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 houre 或 our，h 起初不发音，后来才读出。

items.en: Modern English built hourly, hourglass and rush hour.
items.cn: 现代英语派生 hourly、hourglass，并造出 rush hour。

note.en: Group one holds silent-h words; group two holds units and moments of time.
note.cn: 第一组是 h 不发音的词；第二组是时间单位与时刻词。

entries.definition: every hour, or paid by the hour
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「每小时一次；按小时计」

entries.definition: a glass timer shaped like two joined cones
entries.definitionCN: hour + glass 复合，义为「沙漏」

entries.definition: belonging to us; sounds the same as hour
entries.definitionCN: our 是物主代词「我们的」，与 hour 同音异义

entries.definition: a period of sixty seconds; one sixtieth of an hour
entries.definitionCN: 分钟，小时的六十分之一

entries.definition: a very short point of time
entries.definitionCN: 片刻，强调极短

entries.definition: a period of twenty-four hours
entries.definitionCN: 一天，二十四小时

normalIntro.en: Use the silent h and the clock image.
normalIntro.cn: 用不发音的 h 与钟面意象记 hour。

normal.en: hour, honest, honour: three silent-h words
normal.cn: hour、honest、honour：三个 h 不发音的词。

normal.en: an hour, not a hour: it starts with a vowel sound
normal.cn: 说 an hour：hour 以元音开头。

normal.en: hour and our sound the same: your hour, our hour
normal.cn: hour 与 our 同音：你的时刻，我们的时刻。

normal.en: rush hour is when the streets fill up
normal.cn: rush hour＝街道被塞满的时刻＝高峰期。

normal.en: the hour hand is short, the minute hand is long
normal.cn: 时针短，分针长——hour 是短针走过的一圈。

abstract.en: Picture the long hand closing a slow circle and resting.
abstract.cn: 想象长针慢慢合拢一个圆，然后轻轻停住。

abstract.en: Picture sand falling in a glass until the top chamber is empty.
abstract.cn: 想象沙漏里的沙从上格漏空——一小时。

abstract.en: Feel a train ride measured not in kilometres but in hours.
abstract.cn: 把一段车程感受成用小时而非公里来丈量。

examples.en: The doctor will see you in half an hour.
examples.cn: 医生半小时后给你看诊。

examples.en: The museum’s opening hours changed in winter.
examples.cn: 博物馆的开放时间在冬季有变化。

examples.en: They talked hour after hour on the quiet platform.
examples.cn: 他们在安静的月台上聊了一个又一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「澳尔」——时针走完一整圈，我们（our）就又过了一 hour（小时），两个词读音正好一样。

root: hour 经古法语 houre 来自拉丁 hora「小时」，拉丁词借自希腊语 hora（时节、钟点），后者又源自东方；属外来词而非日耳曼本族词。

sensesIntro.en: From one full circle of the clock, hour widens to fixed moments and to timetables.
sensesIntro.cn: hour 从钟面的一整圈，扩展到一天中固定的时刻，再到作息与营业时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the long hand closing one full circle
core.cn: 核心意象：长针合拢的整整一圈

branches.en: the measured block of sixty minutes
branches.cn: 六十分钟的计量块（义项 01）

branches.en: the named moment it points to
branches.cn: 它所指出的有名有姓的时刻（义项 02）

branches.en: the set of moments turned into a timetable
branches.cn: 时刻集合而成的作息表（义项 03）

branches.en: a length of time becomes a place in the day
branches.cn: 一段时长变成一天中的位置（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: hours as working times
branches.cn: 指工作与营业时间（义项 03）

intro.en: Hour is a small Latin-root noun with a compact English family.
intro.cn: hour 是源于拉丁语的小名词，英语词族紧凑。

latinIntro.en: Latin hora, and Greek hora before it, are the ancestors; horology, the study of timekeeping, shares them.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 hora 及其前的希腊 hora 是其祖先；钟表学 horology 也出自同一来源。

items.structure: Old French houre, from Latin hora
items.example: The class lasts one hour.
The shuttle bus runs hourly.
She turned the hourglass over again.

items.meaning: the short hand of a clock
items.example: The hour hand pointed at four.
Leave early to miss the rush hour.
Hora also gave horoscope, hour of birth.
items.exampleCN: hora 还派生 horoscope（出生时刻）。

items.meaning: the study and craft of clocks
items.example: Horology studies every kind of clock.
items.exampleCN: 钟表学研究各类计时器。

items.example: Wait five more minutes.

definition_zh: 房子；住宅；议院；（动词）给……房子住；收藏
definition_en: a building where people live, or a group that meets to govern; as a verb, to give a place to stay or to keep something inside
core_image: 一栋带门牌号的独立小楼：屋顶、墙、门，和门后的一家人
scene: 街角那栋红顶小楼就是他家，门口的邮筒上写着门牌号。They have just bought a house with a small garden.
sceneCN: 这里 house 是名词「房子；住宅」（第 1 个义项：供人居住的建筑）；他们刚买了一栋带小花园的房子。

collocations.zh: 议会大厦（英国上下议院）

derivatives.zh: house + hold → 家庭；一家人；家庭的
house + -ing → 住房；住房供给
house + work → 家务活
ware（货物）+ house → 仓库

senses.title: A building for living in
senses.definition: a building that people live in, usually for one family
senses.definitionCN: 供人居住的建筑，通常住一户人家
senses.example: Their new house has three bedrooms and a red roof.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的新房子有三间卧室和一个红屋顶。
senses.why: The core sense is the shell with a door: walls built around one family’s life.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是一扇带门的壳：围着一家人生活砌起来的墙。

senses.title: A group that governs or a noble family
senses.definition: a group of people who meet to make laws, or a famous family line
senses.definitionCN: 制定法律的机构，或著名的家族世系
senses.example: The House of Commons discussed the new law yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 下议院昨天讨论了那部新法律。
senses.why: A great house once meant the family in the great house; the name then passed to their seat of power.
senses.whyCN: 「大家族」曾指住大宅的世系，这名字后来转指他们掌权的议席。

senses.title: To provide a place for (verb)
senses.titleCN: 给……房子住；安顿；收藏（动词）
senses.definition: to give someone or something a place to stay, or to keep something inside a building
senses.definitionCN: 为某人某物提供落脚处，或把某物收藏在建筑内
senses.example: The new library houses over fifty thousand books.
senses.exampleCN: 新图书馆藏书五万多册。
senses.why: The noun becomes a verb: the walls now receive and hold what is put inside them.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词：墙壁如今用来收容放进来的东西。

intro.en: House comes from Old English hus, the native Germanic word for a dwelling.
intro.cn: house 来自古英语 hus，是日耳曼语族表示居所的本族词。

items.en: Old English hus named any sheltered dwelling, from cottage to hall.
items.cn: 古英语 hus 泛指有遮蔽的居所，从茅舍到大厅皆可称。

items.en: The root is Germanic: German Haus, Dutch huis and Icelandic hus keep the same shape.
items.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族：德语 Haus、荷兰语 huis、冰岛语 hus 同形。

items.en: In Middle English the noun settled as house and the verb use appeared.
items.cn: 中古英语定形为 house，动词用法随之出现。

items.en: House was also applied to assemblies: the houses of lords and commons took the name.
items.cn: house 也被用于议事机构：上下两院借用了这个名字。

items.en: Modern English built a large compound family: household, housework, warehouse, housing.
items.cn: 现代英语以其为轴造出大量复合词：household、housework、warehouse、housing。

note.en: Group one shows the house compounds; group two shows other words for dwellings.
note.cn: 第一组是 house 复合词；第二组是表示居所的其他词。

entries.definition: all the people living in one house
entries.definitionCN: house + hold 复合，义为「家庭；一家人」

entries.definition: houses in general; the supply of homes
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「住房；住房问题」

entries.definition: a large animal people ride; only the spelling is close
entries.definitionCN: 马，与 house 只是拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: the place where you belong, with the feeling
entries.definitionCN: 家，带有归属感

entries.definition: a set of rooms in a larger building; called apartment in American English
entries.definitionCN: 公寓（英式），美式称 apartment

entries.definition: a small house in the country
entries.definitionCN: 乡间小屋；小别墅

normalIntro.en: Use the compounds and the s-sound family.
normalIntro.cn: 用复合词与 s 音家族记 house。

normal.en: house + hold = the family held in one house
normal.cn: house + hold＝被一所房子「容纳」的一家人＝家庭。

normal.en: house and horse: the first has a roof, the second has hooves
normal.cn: house 与 horse：一个有屋顶，一个有马蹄——拼写别混。

normal.en: move house is the British way to say move home
normal.cn: move house 是英式「搬家」的说法。

normal.en: the verb housed gives a place to stay
normal.cn: 动词 housed＝提供了落脚处＝安顿、收藏。

normal.en: ware + house = warehouse, a house for goods
normal.cn: ware + house＝仓库，存放货物的「房子」。

abstract.en: Picture a small red roof rising above the trees at dusk.
abstract.cn: 想象黄昏时树梢上方露出的一角红屋顶。

abstract.en: Picture a door number shining under a small lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象小灯照亮的门牌号——那扇门只属于一家人。

abstract.en: Feel walls as hands cupped around a family’s evenings.
abstract.cn: 把墙感受成捧着一家人夜晚的手掌。

examples.en: There is a small shop next to their house.
examples.cn: 他们家隔壁有一家小店。

examples.en: The museum houses paintings from the Tang dynasty.
examples.cn: 这家博物馆收藏着唐代画作。

examples.en: Prices of houses in the city keep rising.
examples.cn: 城里的房价一直在涨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「号舍」——门牌号（号）挂在门前的那间舍，就是 house（房子）。

root: house 来自古英语 hus「居所」，属日耳曼本族词，德语 Haus、荷兰语 huis 同源；动词用法与议院义均由名词引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: From a family dwelling, house grew into parliament halls and into the verb of giving shelter.
sensesIntro.cn: house 从一家人住的宅子，长出议会大厅之义，又转出「提供住所」的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: walls and a door wrapped around one family
core.cn: 核心意象：围着一家人砌起的墙与一扇门

branches.en: the building that a family lives in
branches.cn: 一家人居住的建筑（义项 01）

branches.en: the great family turned governing body
branches.cn: 由大宅家族引申的议事机构（义项 02）

branches.en: the walls receiving what is placed inside
branches.cn: 收容内里之物的墙壁（义项 03）

branches.en: people and things are housed alike
branches.cn: 人与物都能被「安置」（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: the House speaks for the land
branches.cn: 议院为整个国家发声（义项 02）

intro.en: House is a native noun that leads a long line of compounds.
intro.cn: house 是本族名词，带出长长一串复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin domus is the classical counterpart, as with home; both families mean dwelling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 domus 是古典对照词（同 home 条）；两个词族都表示居所。

items.example: The house stands alone on the hill.
items.exampleCN: 那栋房子孤零零立在山上。

items.example: Every household in the street received a notice.

items.meaning: homes in general; the supply of homes
items.example: The city faces a housing problem.
items.exampleCN: 这座城市面临住房问题。

items.example: Housework takes her two hours a day.
The rice is kept in a warehouse.

items.meaning: given a place to stay; stored
items.example: The books are housed in glass cases.
items.exampleCN: 书籍被收藏在玻璃柜中。

items.meaning: the elected law-making assembly in Britain
items.example: The House of Commons meets this afternoon.
Domus builds domestic and dome.
items.exampleCN: domus 派生出 domestic 与 dome。

definition_zh: 怎样；如何；多么（用于感叹）；（问程度）多少
definition_en: in what way or by what method; used to ask about manner, degree or state, or to show strong feeling
core_image: 一个张开手掌的问路姿势：不问「哪条路」，只问「怎么走」
scene: 弟弟盯着新魔方翻来覆去，开口便是一连串问句。How does this magic cube work?
sceneCN: 这里 how 是疑问副词「怎样；如何」（第 1 个义项：问方式）；弟弟想知道魔方的玩法是怎么一回事。

collocations.zh: 你好（初次见面的客套语）

derivatives.zh: how + ever → 然而；无论如何
how 的古旧变体（方言中指山凹）
how + to → 入门指导（如 a how-to book）

senses.title: In what way or manner
senses.definition: in what way or by what method something happens or is done
senses.definitionCN: 某事以什么方式发生或完成
senses.example: How do you get to school every day?
senses.exampleCN: 你每天怎么去上学？
senses.why: The core sense points at the path, not the place: the way of doing something.
senses.whyCN: 核心义指向「路径」而非「地点」：做一件事的方式。

senses.title: To what degree or amount
senses.definition: used to ask about degree, amount or number
senses.definitionCN: 询问程度、数量或大小
senses.example: How much does the ticket cost?
senses.exampleCN: 这张票多少钱？
senses.why: The same question word measures: how long, how far, how many all count degrees.
senses.whyCN: 同一个疑问词被用来计量：how long、how far、how many 都在数程度。

senses.title: Used to show strong feeling
senses.definition: used before an adjective to show strong feeling in an exclamation
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容词前表达强烈感受
senses.example: How beautiful the snow looks on the roof!
senses.exampleCN: 屋顶上的雪多美啊！
senses.why: The question shape becomes an exclamation: no answer is wanted, only wonder.
senses.whyCN: 问句的外壳变成感叹：不求回答，只求惊叹。

senses.title: The way something happens (in statements)
senses.definition: used to introduce a clause that describes a way or manner in statements
senses.definitionCN: 在陈述句中引出描述方式的从句
senses.example: This is how the story ended.
senses.exampleCN: 故事就是这样结束的。
senses.why: The question turns into a report: the way itself becomes the answer told.
senses.whyCN: 疑问变成了陈述：方式本身成了被告知的答案。

intro.en: How is an Old English word, hu, a native question adverb of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: how 是古英语词 hu，属日耳曼语源的本族疑问副词。

items.en: Old English hu asked about manner and measure, much as today.
items.cn: 古英语 hu 询问方式与数量，与今天相差不大。

items.en: The root is Germanic: Dutch hoe and German wie fill the same role.
items.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族：荷兰语 hoe、德语 wie 功能相同。

items.en: In Middle English how grew exclamation and clause uses beside questions.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，how 在疑问之外发展出感叹与从句用法。

items.en: Modern English built how much, how come, how-to and however.
items.cn: 现代英语造出 how much、how come、how-to 与 however。

items.en: The deeper root is reconstructed only and not fully agreed on.
items.cn: 更深词根只有重构形式，学界尚无定论。

note.en: Group one keeps the how family; group two keeps other question words.
note.cn: 第一组是 how 词族；第二组是其他疑问词。

entries.definition: to whatever degree; nevertheless
entries.definitionCN: how + ever 复合，义为「无论多么；然而」

entries.definition: giving practical instructions
entries.definitionCN: how + to 复合，义为「入门指导的」

entries.definition: at the present time; only one letter differs
entries.definitionCN: now 是「现在」，与 how 只差一个字母

entries.definition: asking for a thing or fact, not a way
entries.definitionCN: what 问事物或事实，how 问方式

entries.definition: asking for a reason
entries.definitionCN: why 问原因，how 问过程

entries.definition: asking for a choice from a known set
entries.definitionCN: which 在已知范围内做选择

normalIntro.en: Use the fixed question phrases to fix the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用固定疑问短语把 how 记牢。

normal.en: how + much, how + many: two ways to count
normal.cn: how much 与 how many：两种提问数量的方式。

normal.en: how come is an informal why
normal.cn: how come 是口语版 why：怎么会。

normal.en: how about a walk? suggests an idea
normal.cn: how about a walk?＝提议出去走走。

normal.en: how + ever = however, whatever degree or however it is
normal.cn: how + ever＝however：无论多么；然而。

normal.en: how does it work asks for the path, not the reason
normal.cn: how does it work 问的是过程路径，不是原因。

abstract.en: Picture an open hand pointing at a road: not where, but how.
abstract.cn: 想象一只张开的手指着一条路：不问哪里，只问怎么走。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler pulled longer and longer for how long, how far.
abstract.cn: 想象一把被越拉越长的尺——how long、how far 在量长度。

abstract.en: Feel how beautiful as a breath before applause.
abstract.cn: 把 how beautiful 感受成鼓掌前的那一口惊叹。

examples.en: How do you say this word in English?
examples.cn: 这个词用英语怎么说？

examples.en: How quickly the year has passed!
examples.cn: 这一年过得真快啊！

examples.en: Nobody saw how the trick was done.
examples.cn: 没人看出那个戏法是怎么变的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「好」——先问一声「好（how）」，到底是怎么样做的？how 就是「怎么」。

root: how 来自古英语 hu「怎样」，属日耳曼本族疑问副词，荷兰语 hoe、德语 wie 同功能；更深词根属重构，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: One small word asks the way, measures the amount, sighs in wonder and reports the method.
sensesIntro.cn: how 一个词身兼四职：问方式、问程度、发感叹、引陈述。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open hand asking for the way, not the place
core.cn: 核心意象：摊开的手，问路而不问地点

branches.en: the manner of an action
branches.cn: 做事的方式（义项 01）

branches.en: the ruler measuring degree
branches.cn: 计量程度的尺（义项 02）

branches.en: wonder wearing a question mark
branches.cn: 戴着问号的惊叹（义项 03）

branches.en: the way told as an answer
branches.cn: 被当作答案讲述的方式（义项 04）

branches.en: the question and its answer share one word
branches.cn: 提问与回答共用一个词（义项 01 · 04）

intro.en: How is a bare native adverb that loves to sit at the front of compounds.
intro.cn: how 是光杆本族副词，最喜欢站在复合词开头。

latinIntro.en: Latin quomodo, in what way, is the classical counterpart; modo builds mode and model.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quomodo（以何种方式）是古典对照词；modo 派生 mode 与 model。

items.meaning: in what way; to what degree
items.example: How did the vase break?
However hard it rains, we will start.
items.exampleCN: 无论雨多大，我们都出发。

items.example: a how-to video for beginners
items.exampleCN: 一个新手入门教学视频

items.example: How much milk is left?
How come you are late again?
How about some tea?
What is in the box?

items.meaningCN: 以何种方式（拉丁对照词）
items.example: Quomodo contains modo, way.

definition_zh: 然而；可是；无论如何；不管多么
definition_en: used to introduce a contrast with what was said before, or to say that it makes no difference how much or how
core_image: 话说到一半，手臂横着一挡：先停一下，再说「但是」
scene: 天气预报说有雨，他仍背起书包出了门。The sky was dark; however, we still went out to play.
sceneCN: 这里 however 是副词「然而；可是」（第 1 个义项：引出转折）；天色很暗，但我们还是出门玩了。

pos.zh: 不管用什么方式；无论多么

collocations.zh: 随你怎么弄；以你喜欢的任何方式

derivatives.zh: what + ever → 无论什么
when + ever → 无论何时
where + ever → 无论哪里
who + ever → 无论是谁

senses.title: Introducing a contrast
senses.definition: used to join a sentence that contrasts with the one before it
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出与前文意思相反的句子
senses.example: The plan sounded easy. However, it took two weeks to finish.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划听起来容易。然而，实际花了两周才完成。
senses.why: The core use is a small stop sign between two opposite statements.
senses.whyCN: 核心用法是立在两个相反说法之间的小小停车牌。

senses.title: No matter how much or how
senses.definition: used to say that degree or manner makes no difference to the result
senses.definitionCN: 表示程度或方式都不影响结果
senses.example: However hard he tried, the door would not open.
senses.exampleCN: 无论他多用力推，门都打不开。
senses.why: The question word how keeps its old job: however repeats the question and cancels it.
senses.whyCN: 疑问词 how 保留原职：however 把疑问重复一遍又把它取消。

senses.title: In whatever way one chooses
senses.definition: in whatever manner someone chooses or manages
senses.definitionCN: 以某人选择的任何方式
senses.example: Do it however you like; the result is yours.
senses.exampleCN: 随你怎么做，结果由你负责。
senses.why: All the possible ways are swept together and given away as a free choice.
senses.whyCN: 所有可能的方式被一揽子收起，交还成一份自由选择。

intro.en: However is simply how plus ever, an English compound that grew in the Middle English period.
intro.cn: however 就是 how 加 ever，是中古英语时期长出的英语复合词。

items.en: Old English hu asked the manner; ever has the sense of at any time.
items.cn: 古英语 hu 问方式；ever 义为「在任何时候」。

items.en: In Middle English, how ever was first two words, then joined into however.
items.cn: 中古英语中 how ever 起初分写，后来合并成 however。

items.en: The contrast use developed beside the no-matter use in the same period.
items.cn: 同一时期，「转折」用法与「无论」用法并行发展。

items.en: Modern English family grew parallel forms: whatever, whenever, wherever, whoever.
items.cn: 现代英语长出平行家族：whatever、whenever、wherever、whoever。

items.en: Both halves are Germanic native words, like how itself.
items.cn: 两半都是日耳曼本族词，与 how 一脉相承。

note.en: Group one keeps the ever compounds; group two keeps contrast words.
note.cn: 第一组是 -ever 复合词；第二组是表示转折的近义词。

entries.definition: no matter what
entries.definitionCN: 同构词，义为「无论什么」

entries.definition: no matter when; at any time
entries.definitionCN: 同构词，义为「无论何时」

entries.definition: no matter who
entries.definitionCN: 同构词，义为「无论是谁」

entries.definition: the shortest contrast word
entries.definitionCN: but，最短的转折词

entries.definition: in spite of that
entries.definitionCN: 尽管如此，较正式

entries.definition: used to add a surprising contrast
entries.definitionCN: yet，引出令人意外的对比

normalIntro.en: Split the word and use the -ever family.
normalIntro.cn: 拆开这个词，用 -ever 家族记它。

normal.en: how + ever = however: the question repeated and cancelled
normal.cn: how + ever＝however：疑问被重复又被取消＝无论如何。

normal.en: however hard, however late: degree does not matter
normal.cn: however hard、however late：程度再大也不影响结果。

normal.en: however, with a comma, means but between sentences
normal.cn: however 后加逗号＝句间的「但是」。

normal.en: whatever, whenever, whoever follow the same pattern
normal.cn: whatever、whenever、whoever 与 it 同构。

normal.en: however you like hands the choice to you
normal.cn: however you like＝选择权交给你＝随你怎么做。

abstract.en: Picture a raised hand stopping a sentence in mid-air.
abstract.cn: 想象一只抬起的把句子拦在半空的手——转折的停顿。

abstract.en: Picture rain, storm and wind, yet the little boat sails on regardless.
abstract.cn: 想象风雨交加，小船照样前行——无论如何。

abstract.en: Feel however as a door that opens no matter how you push it.
abstract.cn: 把 however 感受成一扇怎么推都会开的门。

examples.en: He was tired; however, he finished all his homework.
examples.cn: 他很累了，然而他仍然做完了全部作业。

examples.en: However cold it is, the old man swims every morning.
examples.cn: 无论多冷，老人每天早晨都游泳。

examples.en: You may arrange the desks however you like.
examples.cn: 课桌随你怎么摆都行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「好外娃」——好在外面起了个娃（转折小插曲），however 就是「然而」里带的那个意外。

root: however 由本族词 how（怎样）+ ever（任何）复合而成，中古英语由分写合为一词；与 whatever、whenever 等同构，皆属日耳曼成分。

sensesIntro.en: However both blocks a sentence with a contrast and sweeps away every degree and manner.
sensesIntro.cn: however 一手立转折、一手抹平一切程度与方式：既当「然而」，又当「无论多么」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a raised hand that stops and then releases
core.cn: 核心意象：先拦住、再放行的抬手

branches.en: the stop sign before a contrast
branches.cn: 转折前的停车牌（义项 01）

branches.en: the degree that changes nothing
branches.cn: 不影响结果的任何程度（义项 02）

branches.en: the choice handed back free
branches.cn: 交还的自由选择（义项 03）

branches.en: contrast and concession share one word
branches.cn: 转折与让步共用一词（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: nothing and everything both allowed
branches.cn: 什么都不设限，什么都允许（义项 02 · 03）

intro.en: However is built from two native words and heads a whole family of -ever compounds.
intro.cn: however 由两个本族词构成，并带出一整族 -ever 复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin qualitercumque, in whatever way, is the classical counterpart.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 qualitercumque（无论以何方式）是古典对照词。

items.example: However you see it, it is a loss.
items.exampleCN: 无论你怎么看，这都是损失。

items.example: ever strengthens the question word
items.exampleCN: ever 起强化疑问词的作用

items.example: Whatever happens, stay calm.
items.exampleCN: 无论发生什么，都要冷静。

items.example: Come whenever you are free.
items.exampleCN: 你什么时候有空就什么时候来。

items.example: Sit wherever you like.
Whoever comes is welcome.
It rained; nevertheless we marched on.
items.exampleCN: 天下着雨，尽管如此我们仍继续前进。

items.meaningCN: 无论以何方式（拉丁对照词）
items.example: Built from qualiter plus cumque.
items.exampleCN: 由 qualiter 与 cumque 构成。

definition_zh: 拥抱；搂抱；（名词）拥抱
definition_en: to put your arms around someone and hold them close to show love or comfort
core_image: 两条手臂围成的一个圈：把一个人整个圈进怀里
scene: 火车进站，妹妹冲过人群扑进哥哥怀里。She gave her brother a big hug at the station.
sceneCN: 这里 hug 是名词「拥抱」（第 1 个义项：搂抱的动作）；她在车站给了哥哥一个大大的拥抱。

collocations.zh: 紧贴着树（或环保式的抱树）

derivatives.zh: hug + -ing → 拥抱（动名词）
近义相关词 → 依偎；搂着轻抚
bear + hug → 熊抱
hug + -able → 让人想抱的；软乎乎可爱的

senses.title: To hold someone close with the arms
senses.definition: to put your arms around someone and press them close
senses.definitionCN: 用双臂环住某人并紧紧搂在怀里
senses.example: Grandma hugged the children before they left for school.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们上学前，奶奶把他们搂在怀里。
senses.why: The core act is two arms closing into a circle around a person.
senses.whyCN: 核心动作是两条手臂围人合拢成一个圈。

senses.title: To hold or fit closely around something
senses.definition: to fit or stay very close to something, as clothes or a road hugging a shape
senses.definitionCN: 指衣服贴身，或道路紧贴地形延伸
senses.example: The road hugs the coast for twenty kilometres.
senses.exampleCN: 公路沿着海岸线延伸了二十公里。
senses.why: Arms around a person become a border around a shape: the close circle moves onto things.
senses.whyCN: 环抱人的双臂变成围住轮廓的边线：这个「圈」挪到了事物上。

senses.title: To keep a feeling close to oneself
senses.definition: to keep a feeling secretly close inside oneself
senses.definitionCN: 把某种情感悄悄揣在心里
senses.example: She hugged the memory of that summer for many years.
senses.exampleCN: 那个夏天的记忆她珍藏了许多年。
senses.why: What the arms do to a person, the heart does to a memory: held close and not let go.
senses.whyCN: 手臂对人所做的，心对记忆也照做：紧紧收着，不肯松开。

intro.en: Hug is a Nordic word borrowed into English in the sixteenth century; Old Norse hugga meant to comfort.
intro.cn: hug 是十六世纪从北欧借入英语的词；古诺斯语 hugga 意为安慰。

items.en: Old Norse hugga meant to comfort and soothe, built on hugr, meaning mind and spirit.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 hugga 意为安抚、慰藉，词根是 hugr「心灵、精神」。

items.en: Danish and Norwegian kept related words for comforting embraces.
items.cn: 丹麦语、挪威语保留了表示安慰式拥抱的关联词。

items.en: There are rare Middle English traces, but the word settled later.
items.cn: 中古英语偶见踪迹，但真正定型较晚。

items.en: From the sixteenth century, hug named the close embrace itself.
items.cn: 十六世纪起，hug 指那种紧紧的拥抱。

items.en: Modern English widened it to roads, clothes and hidden feelings.
items.cn: 现代英语又把它扩展到道路、衣物与藏于心底的情感。

note.en: Group one keeps the embrace family; group two keeps close-contact near words.
note.cn: 第一组是拥抱词族；第二组是亲密接触的近义词。

entries.definition: the past form of hug, with double g
entries.definitionCN: hug 的过去式，双写 g 再加 ed

entries.definition: so soft that people want to hug it
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「让人想抱的」

entries.definition: the centre of a wheel or network; only spelling is close
entries.definitionCN: hub 是「轮毂；中心」，与 hug 只是拼写相近

entries.definition: to hold someone closely in the arms
entries.definitionCN: 拥抱，较正式的说法

entries.definition: to hold gently and lovingly for a long time
entries.definitionCN: 依偎；轻抚，时间长且温柔

entries.definition: to hold tightly with the hand or arms
entries.definitionCN: 紧握；紧抱，强调用力

normalIntro.en: Use the double-g spelling and the circle image.
normalIntro.cn: 用双写 g 的拼写与「圈」的意象记 hug。

normal.en: hug, hugged, hugging: double the g before -ed and -ing
normal.cn: hug 变形要双写 g：hugged、hugging。

normal.en: give somebody a hug is the everyday phrase
normal.cn: give somebody a hug 是日常说法：给个拥抱。

normal.en: a bear hug wraps you twice over
normal.cn: bear hug 熊抱＝把你整个裹住的大拥抱。

normal.en: Old Norse hugr means mind: the hug holds the heart
normal.cn: 古诺斯语 hugr 意为心：拥抱搂住的不只是身体。

normal.en: the road hugs the coast like an arm around a shoulder
normal.cn: 公路 hug 海岸，像手臂环着肩膀。

abstract.en: Picture two arms closing like a gate around one person.
abstract.cn: 想象两条手臂像两扇门在一个人身前合拢。

abstract.en: Picture a coat that hugs your shoulders on a cold morning.
abstract.cn: 想象冷天早晨紧贴肩头的外套——贴合义。

abstract.en: Feel a memory kept warm in the middle of the chest.
abstract.cn: 感受胸口正中被焐得温热的记忆——心怀义。

examples.en: The two friends hugged each other goodbye at the gate.
examples.cn: 两个朋友在大门口拥抱道别。

examples.en: A warm hug can say more than a long speech.
examples.cn: 一个温暖的拥抱胜过千言万语。

examples.en: The path hugs the river all the way to the village.
examples.cn: 小路沿着河流一直延伸到村庄。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈格」——张开手臂「哈」地一声把人围成一「格」，这就是 hug（拥抱）。

root: hug 是十六世纪自斯堪的纳维亚借入的词，源自古诺斯语 hugga「安慰」，词根为 hugr「心灵、精神」；与日耳曼本族 embrace 一系无关。

sensesIntro.en: From arms around a person, hug spreads to roads hugging coasts and hearts hugging memories.
sensesIntro.cn: hug 从环抱人的手臂，扩展到贴着海岸的公路、揣在心里的记忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two arms closing into one circle
core.cn: 核心意象：两条手臂合拢成的一个圈

branches.en: the arms around a person
branches.cn: 环住人的双臂（义项 01）

branches.en: the circle drawn around a shape
branches.cn: 贴着轮廓画出的圈（义项 02）

branches.en: the heart holding a feeling close
branches.cn: 把情感收在怀里的心（义项 03）

branches.en: bodies and memories are held alike
branches.cn: 身体与记忆同样被「抱住」（义项 01 · 03）

branches.en: close fit without arms
branches.cn: 不需要手臂的贴合（义项 02）

intro.en: Hug is a short borrowed word with a small modern family.
intro.cn: hug 是个短小的借词，词族不大且较新。

latinIntro.en: Latin complecti, to clasp, is the classical source of embrace, given for contrast.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 complecti「环抱」是 embrace 的古典来源，列出作对照。

items.meaning: to hold close in the arms
items.example: Hug your sister goodbye.
Hugga carries the idea of comfort.
Hugr is the root inside hugga.
items.exampleCN: hugr 是 hugga 内部的词根。

items.example: She hugged the teddy bear all night.
items.exampleCN: 她整夜抱着那只泰迪熊。

items.example: a huggable old pillow
items.exampleCN: 一只让人想抱的旧枕头

items.example: The coach gave him a bear hug.

items.meaning: to hold closely; to accept gladly
items.example: Embrace also means to accept new ideas.
items.exampleCN: embrace 也指欣然接受新观念。

items.example: Com- means with and plecti to weave.
items.exampleCN: com- 表示共同，plecti 表示编绕。

definition_zh: 巨大的；庞大的；（口语）程度极大的
definition_en: extremely large in size, amount or degree; very important
core_image: 抬起头也看不到顶的那一堵墙：把寻常的尺寸全部挡在身后
scene: 站在山脚仰头看，一块巨石挡住了半边天。The huge rock blocked half of the sky.
sceneCN: 这里 huge 是「巨大的」（第 1 个义项：体积极其大）；那块巨石大到遮住了半边天空。

pos.zh: 巨大的；庞大的；程度极大的

derivatives.zh: huge + -ly → 极大地；非常
huge + -ness → 巨大；庞大
近义相关词 → 巨大的；巨人
拉丁词源近义词 → 极大的

senses.title: Extremely large in size
senses.definition: very large in physical size
senses.definitionCN: 物理体积非常大
senses.example: A huge whale swam beside the little boat.
senses.exampleCN: 一头巨鲸在小船旁游过。
senses.why: The core sense is size so large that it dwarfs everything near it.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是大到让周围一切显得渺小。

senses.title: Very large in amount or degree
senses.definition: very large in quantity, number or strength
senses.definitionCN: 数量、数目或强度非常大
senses.example: The show was a huge success last night.
senses.exampleCN: 昨晚的演出大获成功。
senses.why: The measuring stick moves from metres to numbers and feelings.
senses.whyCN: 丈量的尺子从米换成了数字与感受。

senses.title: Very important
senses.definition: having great importance or effect
senses.definitionCN: 具有重要性或重大影响
senses.example: Transport plays a huge role in city life.
senses.exampleCN: 交通在城市生活中扮演着极其重要的角色。
senses.why: What overflows the scale also overflows the list of ordinary things.
senses.whyCN: 超出量尺的东西同样超出了寻常事物的名单。

intro.en: Huge came from Old French ahuge, meaning great or mighty, of uncertain deeper origin.
intro.cn: huge 来自古法语 ahuge「巨大、强大」，更深的来源不确定。

items.en: Old French ahuge meant enormous and mighty, perhaps of a Germanic word for fear.
items.cn: 古法语 ahuge 意为巨大而威猛，可能源自某个与「恐惧」相关的日耳曼词。

items.en: Middle English borrowed huge in the thirteenth century for physical bigness.
items.cn: 中古英语于十三世纪借入 huge，先指形体庞大。

items.en: Spelling varied between huger, huge and hewge in early records.
items.cn: 早期记录中拼写多样：huger、huge、hewge 并存。

items.en: Modern English widened huge to amounts, successes and importance.
items.cn: 现代英语把 huge 扩展到数量、成就与重要性。

items.en: The deeper root is not agreed on; the fear theory is only one guess.
items.cn: 更深词根尚无定论，「恐惧说」只是猜想之一。

note.en: Group one keeps the huge family; group two keeps other words of great size.
note.cn: 第一组是 huge 词族；第二组是表示巨大的其他说法。

entries.definition: very much; to a great degree
entries.definitionCN: 同根副词，义为「极大地；非常」

entries.definition: the quality of being very large
entries.definitionCN: 同根名词，义为「巨大；庞大」

entries.definition: big and strong in build, or a sled dog; only the sound is close
entries.definitionCN: husky 指「高大健壮的」或「雪橇犬」，与 huge 只是音近

entries.definition: extremely large, beyond the normal size
entries.definitionCN: 巨大的，超出正常尺寸

entries.definition: very large, like a giant in stories
entries.definitionCN: 巨大的，如故事中的巨人一般

entries.definition: extremely large in area or extent
entries.definitionCN: 广阔的，多指面积与范围

normalIntro.en: Use the family and fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 用词族与固定搭配记 huge。

normal.en: huge + -ly = hugely, to a great degree
normal.cn: huge + -ly＝hugely，程度极大。

normal.en: a huge success is a success over the normal scale
normal.cn: a huge success＝超出常规刻度的成功。

normal.en: huge waves climb higher than the ship
normal.cn: huge waves＝比船还高的巨浪。

normal.en: enormous carries the Latin sense of out-of-norm
normal.cn: enormous 带拉丁义「超出规范」＝巨大。

normal.en: huge and tiny are the two ends of the size ruler
normal.cn: huge 与 tiny 是尺寸尺的两端。

abstract.en: Picture a wall so tall that birds must turn back at half height.
abstract.cn: 想象一堵高到飞鸟飞到一半就折返的墙——huge。

abstract.en: Picture applause that keeps swelling until it fills the hall.
abstract.cn: 想象掌声越涨越大直到灌满整个礼堂——huge success。

abstract.en: Feel the word as a doorframe you have to bend down to pass.
abstract.cn: 把这个词感受成需要弯腰才能通过的门框。

examples.en: A huge crowd waited outside the gate.
examples.cn: 大门外等候着一大群人。

examples.en: Moving the piano made a huge difference to the room.
examples.cn: 挪走钢琴让房间显得大不一样。

examples.en: The bridge was a hugely expensive project.
examples.cn: 这座桥是一项耗资巨大的工程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休极」——仰头望到休（罢）了也看不到极顶，真是 huge（巨大的）。

root: huge 来自古法语 ahuge「巨大、威猛」，约十三世纪借入英语；更深的词根来源不确定，「源于日耳曼语「恐惧」一词」仅为假说之一。

sensesIntro.en: Huge first measured bodies, then amounts and successes, finally importance itself.
sensesIntro.cn: huge 先量形体，再量数量与成就，最后量重要性本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scale-busting size that dwarfs all around
core.cn: 核心意象：让周围一切显得渺小的超大尺寸

branches.en: the body too big for its frame
branches.cn: 大到超出框架的形体（义项 01）

branches.en: the number that overflows the page
branches.cn: 漫出纸面的数量（义项 02）

branches.en: the weight of importance
branches.cn: 重要性的分量（义项 03）

branches.en: one ruler measures rocks and crowds
branches.cn: 同一把尺既量巨石也量人潮（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: success that overflows the scale
branches.cn: 超出刻度的成功（义项 02 · 03）

intro.en: Huge is a borrowed adjective with a light modern family.
intro.cn: huge 是借入的形容词，词族轻小而较新。

latinIntro.en: Latin enormis, out of the norm, is the classical counterpart of huge; it builds enormous.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 enormis「超出规范」是 huge 的古典对照词，派生 enormous。

items.example: a huge shadow over the street
The plan worked hugely well.
The hugeness of the sea calmed him.
Ahuge possibly echoes a fear word.
items.exampleCN: ahuge 或与「恐惧」一词相关。

items.example: Huge waves hit the harbour.

items.meaning: out of the norm; extremely large
items.meaningCN: 巨大的（拉丁词源近义词）
items.example: An enormous whale passed the ship.

items.meaningCN: 广阔的（拉丁词源近义词）
items.example: the vast grassland in summer
Parvus is the opposite of magnus.
items.exampleCN: parvus 是 magnus 的反义词。

definition_zh: 人；人类的；人性的；有人情味的
definition_en: a person, or connected with people rather than animals, machines or gods
core_image: 一面既映出神也映出兽的镜子：中间站着的那个会哭会笑的影像
scene: 博物馆的玻璃柜里摆着古人类复原的头骨模型。Human bones were found deep in the cave.
sceneCN: 这里 human 是形容词「人类的」（第 1 个义项：与人类相关）；洞穴深处发现了人骨。

pos.zh: 人的；人类的；有人情味的

derivatives.zh: human + -ity → 人类；人性；仁慈
同源词 → 仁慈的；人道的（拼法接近 human）
human + -ly → 在人力所及的范围内
in-（非）+ human → 无人性的；残忍的

senses.title: Connected with people, not animals or machines
senses.definition: belonging to people, their bodies, minds and society
senses.definitionCN: 属于人及人的身体、心智与社会
senses.example: Reading and writing are special human skills.
senses.exampleCN: 读写是人类特有的技能。
senses.why: The core sense draws a border: on one side animals and machines, on this side people.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是划界：一边是动物与机器，这一边是人。

senses.title: A person (noun)
senses.definition: a member of the human race; a person
senses.definitionCN: 人类的一员；一个人
senses.example: The rescuers found one last human under the fallen roof.
senses.exampleCN: 救援人员在倒塌的屋顶下找到了最后一个人。
senses.why: The adjective steps forward as a noun: the belonging itself names the member.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为名词：归属本身成了成员的名字。

senses.title: Showing weakness and feeling typical of people
senses.titleCN: 有人性弱点的；有人情味的
senses.definition: showing the feelings, mistakes and kindness that people naturally have
senses.definitionCN: 流露出人类自然的情感、过失与善意
senses.example: Even great teachers are human and sometimes forget things.
senses.exampleCN: 再了不起的老师也是人，偶尔也会忘事。
senses.why: The border cuts both ways: to be human is also to err and to care.
senses.whyCN: 这条边界是双向的：作为人，既会犯错，也会体谅。

intro.en: Human comes from Latin humanus, of man, related to homo, a human being, and humus, the ground.
intro.cn: human 来自拉丁 humanus「人的」，与 homo「人」相关，而 homo 又与 humus「泥土」相关联。

items.en: Latin homo meant a human being; the old story links it to humus, the soil from which people were shaped.
items.cn: 拉丁 homo 指人；旧说把它与 humus（泥土）相连，因为人由泥土塑成。

items.en: The adjective humanus meant of man, cultured and kind; it built humanitas, learning and kindness.
items.cn: 形容词 humanus 意为「人的；文明的；仁慈的」，派生 humanitas「人文与仁慈」。

items.en: Old French humain carried the word into medieval English writing.
items.cn: 古法语 humain 把该词带入中世纪英语文本。

items.en: Middle English spelled it humain or humayne; the adjective came first.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 humain 或 humayne，形容词用法先行。

items.en: Modern English added human being, human rights and the noun human.
items.cn: 现代英语造出 human being、human rights，并使 human 兼作名词。

note.en: Group one keeps the Latin family; group two keeps words about people and kindness.
note.cn: 第一组是拉丁词族；第二组是关于人与仁慈的近义词。

entries.definition: kind and merciful to people and animals
entries.definitionCN: 同源词，义为「仁慈的；人道的」

entries.definition: people as a whole; kindness; the humanities
entries.definitionCN: 同根词，义为「人类；仁慈；人文学科」

entries.definition: cruel; without human feeling
entries.definitionCN: 同根反义词，义为「残忍的；无人性的」

entries.definition: a human being considered as an individual
entries.definitionCN: 个人，指一个个具体的人

entries.definition: all human beings together
entries.definitionCN: 人类整体，范围最大的说法

entries.definition: educated and behaving in a fair, ordered way
entries.definitionCN: 开化的；文明的，强调教养与秩序

normalIntro.en: Use the Latin soil story and the family.
normalIntro.cn: 用「泥土造人」的拉丁词源故事与词族记 human。

normal.en: human comes from humus, the soil: people shaped from the ground
normal.cn: human 来自 humus（泥土）：古人相信人由泥土塑成。

normal.en: humane looks like human but means kind and merciful
normal.cn: humane 与 human 形近，意思是「仁慈的」。

normal.en: human + -ity = humanity, people as a whole and kindness
normal.cn: human + -ity＝humanity：人类整体，也是仁慈。

normal.en: in + human = inhuman, without human feeling
normal.cn: in- + human＝inhuman，没有人的感情＝残忍的。

normal.en: a human error means a mistake made by a person
normal.cn: a human error＝人犯的错误＝人为失误。

abstract.en: Picture clay under a sculptor’s hand slowly taking a face.
abstract.cn: 想象雕塑家掌下的泥慢慢显出一张脸——泥土造人。

abstract.en: Picture a mirror showing a lion on one side and an angel on the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一面镜子：一侧映出狮，一侧映出天使，中间站着人。

abstract.en: Feel the word as a handshake between two strangers.
abstract.cn: 把这个词感受成两个陌生人之间的握手——人情味。

examples.en: Only a human can feel sorry for a mistake like this.
examples.cn: 只有人会对这样的错误感到内疚。

examples.en: The robot imitated a human voice almost perfectly.
examples.cn: 机器人几乎完美地模仿了人声。

examples.en: Helping strangers is part of human nature.
examples.cn: 帮助陌生人是人性的一部分。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「休门」——歇了工的人从家门里走出来，一个活生生的人，就是 human（人）。

root: human 来自拉丁 humanus「人的；文明的」，词根 homo「人」旧说与 humus「泥土」相关（人由泥土塑成）；同根词有 humane、humanity、inhuman。

sensesIntro.en: Human first draws the line around people, then names one person, then softens into kindness and error.
sensesIntro.cn: human 先为人类划界，再指单个的人，最后落回人情的柔软与人的过失。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the figure standing between god and beast
core.cn: 核心意象：站在神与兽之间的身影

branches.en: the line around the species
branches.cn: 围出物种边界的线（义项 01）

branches.en: one member named by belonging
branches.cn: 以归属命名的个体（义项 02）

branches.en: the soft side: error and kindness
branches.cn: 柔软的一面：过失与善意（义项 03）

branches.en: the class and its member share one word
branches.cn: 类与成员共用一词（义项 01 · 02）

branches.en: human rights protect the weak side
branches.cn: 人权守护柔软的一面（义项 03）

intro.en: Human heads a rich Latin family of people, kindness and culture.
intro.cn: human 是拉丁「人」词族的首领，涵盖人类、仁慈与文明。

latinIntro.en: Latin homo, hominis and humanus are the ancestors; homo also builds homicide and hominid.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 homo, hominis 与 humanus 是其祖先；homo 还派生 homicide 与 hominid。

items.example: a human voice on the phone
Homo sapiens names our species.
items.exampleCN: Homo sapiens 是我们物种的学名。

items.example: Humanus built humanitas.
Humanity suffered in the war.
a humane society for animals
items.exampleCN: 一个善待动物的人道协会

items.example: Inhuman treatment is forbidden.
Homicide is the gravest crime.

items.meaning: a member of the human family of species
items.example: Hominids walked upright early.
items.exampleCN: 人科动物很早就直立行走。
